840: Patach veamar (Tehillim 147:5) gadol adonenu verav koach vegomer gadol verav veillaa ihu kudesha berich hu. vechi la yadana dekudesha berich hu gadol ihu verav koach, may shevacha dedavid hacha.

Ella bechol atar ihu amar (tehillim kama) gadol Adonai, vehacha amar gadol adoninu. may tama. ella hatam deihu amar gadol Adonai umehulal meod. bedarga illaa kaamar. vehacha dichtiv gadol adonenu bedarga tattaa kaamar, deihu adon kol haaretz. ma ketiv leella mehay kera, mone mispar lakkochavim lechullam shemot yikra. i kol bene alma miyyoma deitbere adam, yitkanneshun lemimne kochavaya, la yachlin lemimne, kema deat amer (Bereshit 15:5) usefor hakkochavim im tuchal lispor otam. vekudesha berich hu ma ketiv beh, mone mispar lakkochavim lechullam shemot yikra. may tama. begin dichtiv gadol adonenu verav koach vegomer. kema delet mispar lekochve shemaya, bar minneh. uf hachi ihu ketiv beh, velitvunato en mispar.

Ta chazi, ketiv (Yeshayahu 40:26) hammotzi vemispar tzevaam vegomer, kullehu chayyaylin umashshiryayn vechochavayya, kudesha berich hu appik lon bishma, kol chad vechad, vela gara afillu chad. bechol kochavayya umazzale dirkiin kullehu, itmenun negidin ufekiddin leshammesha alma, kol chad vechad kadka chazi leh. velet lach isba zeira bechol alma, dela shalta aleh kochava umazzala birkia, veal hahu kochava memana chad, deka meshammesh kameh dekudesha berich hu, kol chad vechad kadka chazi leh.

Kol kochavayya devirkiin kullehu meshammeshe al hay alma, vechullehu pekidan leshammesha kol milla umilla, leinnun dibbehay alma, vela tzamchin vela megaddelin asavin veilanin udeshain, veisve bara, bar bechezu dekochavayya deka kayyme alayyhu, veitchazun alayyhu anpin beanpin, kol chad vechad kema deitchaze leh.

Rov mashshiryayn dekochavayya umazzale, kullehu nafkin bereshita delelya, ad telat shate chaser revia. mittamman ulehala la nafkin bar zeirin. veinnun kochavayya kullehu la meshamshe levattala, vela itchazun levattala. veit kochavaya deka meshamshe kol lelya, begin leatzmecha ulegaddela kol innun millin deitpekadu alayyhu. veit kochavayya deka meshamshe ad palgut lelya, vetzamchin umegaddelin mereshita delelya, ad hahi shaata, kol innun millin deitpekadu alayyhu. veit kochavaya deka meshamshe zeer milelya, dechevan deitchaze bahade hahu isba, o hahu deshaa, miyyad ashlim shimusheh, vela itzterich yattir behahu lelya. veha innun la kayymin levattala, kevan deashlimu shimmushayyhu, la itchazun yattir behay alma, veayylin leatrayyhu.

Besifra dechachmeta illaa divne kedem, amre al kol innun kochavaya (vaychi 223 amud alef, Vayikra 231 amud bet) desharvita, deka meshaddere sharvita birkia, amri daasavin innun beara, meinnun deikrun same dechayye, veavnin yakiran it beara, vezahav shachut dimgadla go ture ramae, bizer mayin dechafya aleh, vela chafya ella denagid aleh, veshaltan al kol illen innun kochavayya desharvita, umegadle illen beginayyhu.
Vechol tikkuna ugedula dilhon, lav ihu ella bechezu venogha dehahu sharvita, deka meshadder hahu kochava, go rekia, ucheden ittaknan umitgadlan kol innun millin.

Marin it bivne nasha, kegon yerokin vekastirin. deasvavta dilhon la tale, ella bechad mare defarzela kalil natzitz leayynin, veit leh lemareh demare leistakkela beh. vela (nusach acher shachich) shayyaych (sefer acher ittassi) behay ad deabar hahu mare lesitra da ulesitra da, kegavvna desharvita, deyoshit netzitzu devarak leanpoy, uvehahu oshitu devarak deka natzitz leayynin, ate leh asvavta. uf hachi, kol innun deshalte alayyhu innun kochavaya, let lon tikkuna ugedula bamme deitchaze, bar hahu peshitu desharvita, uvehay mittatkene, bechezu,
841: Veshappir ihu, deha kegavvna da, ramiz besifra dishlomo malka, bechachmeta deavnin yekirin, dei chaser minnehon nogha dintzitzu ulehitu dekochavayya yedian, la megaddelin, vela (sefer acher mittaknin lealmin) metakkene lon lealmin, vecholla atkin kudesha berich hu letikkuna dealma, kema deat amer (Bereshit 1:15) lehair al haaretz, bechol ma deitzterich behay alma letakkena leh.

Ketiv (shamevatekav) veasita karse nechoshet chamishim, uchetiv veasita chamishim karse zahav, vetanenan, man dela chama innun kerasim bemashkena, la chama nehiru dekochavayya birkia, begin divhahu chezu, uvehahu gavvna, damyayn lechol man deistakkal behu.

Kochavaya it birkia, deillen nafke mehahu rekia, dechol kochavaya addukin tamman. behahu rekia it mea chaloni mashkofin, minnehon listar mizrach, uminnehon listar darom. uvechol chalona vechalona kochava chad.

Vechad shimsha azil beinnun challonin umashkofin di birkia natzitz bintzitzu, veillen kochavayya nafke leitnatztzetza mehahu netzitzu deshimsha veitztabbau, minhon sumakin kegavvna dinchoshet, uminhon yerokin kegavvna dezahav, veal da, illen sumakin, veillen yerokin. chamishshim innun beinnun chamishshim challonin, (nusach acher vachamishshim inun beinnun chalevaneyn) acharanin. delistar mizrach innun yerokin, delistar darom innun sumakin, behu itachad siyyuma demashkena.

Bechol innun kochavaya denafke mehahu rekia, mitarve innun kochavaya belelya, venatztze umelahate veshalte behay alma. minhon al nechoshet, minhon al zahav yerakrak, veittaknan umegadlan al chela dilhon.

Illen kochavaya shalte bech ufalga nekudin delelya, deinnun rige shaata, veinnun dimgadle nechoshet deinnun sumake velahate venatztze. vechad oshitu telat zimnin netzitzu lesitra demizrach, o chamesh, o sheva, malche ammin yiyitun al hahu sitra, vechol utra vedahava yistallak mehahu sitra. vei netzitzu chad, teren, arba, shit, da batar da, emata ufachada yippol, veyishre al hahu sitra. batish netzitzu veshachich, batish netzitzu veshachich, yittearu kerave, vela yitavidu, (davar acher bealma behahu sitra) deha behahu zimna, itaruta hu leella kame kudesha berich hu, beinnun memanan dealma deshaltin al shear ammin, vechen kegavvna da besitra achara.

Patach veamar, (Daniel 2:20) lehve shemeh di elaha mevarach min alma vead alma di chachmeta ugevureta dileh hi. vehu mehashene iddanayya vezimnaya. vecholla ihu birshuteh, veappik leammeh kaddisha, mechela ureshuta dekochavayya umazzale, begin deinnun taavavn acharan vela beillen chulaka deyaakov, ki im (yirmeya 10) beyotzer hakkol hu.

Rakia it leella, al kol illen rekiin, veihu tamir veganiz, vechotama degushepanka demashkena shalta al hay rakia, vehay rakia ikre iddara demashkena, uvehay rakia kol innun challonin, missitra da, umissitra da, veachid kol innun siddurin demashkena. shit (balak 183 amud bet) challonin innun ravrevin al kullehu, vechad satim leshalta alayyhu.

Chalona chad, ikre chalon zohora, uveh nafka kochava chada, deikre lechakkime yad, veda ihu hittucha deka mehattech letatta beshultanuta dihuda. lav deit leh chulaka beh, deha let lashshevatin deyisrael chulaka veachasana behu, ella shivta dihuda shalta al hay, velav ihu aleh.

Vechad astu bene yehuda archayyhu mibbatar kudesha berich hu, azlu leminda batar chalona da, vehay kochava. veamru (sefer acher deha yada) dehay yeda deka menatztzach lishar ammin, dichtiv beh (Bereshit 49:8) yadcha beoref oyvecha, veazlu avatreh veavdu leh shimmusha ufulchana, veal da ketiv, (Melachim 1 14:22) vayyaas yehuda hara beene Adonai.
Hay kochava kad nafik pashit chad yad bachamesh etzbean, nahir venatzitz behahu chalon.
842: Marehon dekusemin vecharshin, dachale mehay atar, begin divshaata dehay shalta, kullehu kesamin vecharshin mitbalbele, vela atzlach bidayyhu.

Vei tema, hoil veihu hay rakia temira, hech yade leh. ella simana it lon levar, veyade deha shalta kochava da, vedachale tadir minneh, vela atzlach bidehon, innun kesamin vecharshin. veal da it zimnin deatzlachu beh beni nasha, veit zimnin dela atzlachu beh. uvegin da innun mare kusemin vecharshin mitmaate mealma, begin dela yadin ikara, kad chaman dela atzlach bidayyhu. veal da innun kadmae havo yade, umistakkelan levar behahu simana, deka yade.

Chalona tinyayna, ikre chalon tufera, begin deihu kegavvna detufera, uveh nafka kochava chad, deikre lechakkimin tzifon, deha da shalta beshuletana takkif bedina beresha vezanva, it leh ketzifon kamin lekatla.

Mehahu chalon, nafke shit mea elef ribbo ruchin, deshaltin al innun tuferin divne nasha, kad izdarkan beitgalleya. behay avde charashin ukesamin, kol innun deyade lon. behahi shaata dehay kochava shalta, kol innun dezarke tufere, (sefer acher i avid) o avde charashin behon, garim mota lechol alma, vesalik charashin bidayyhu deinnun deavde lon.

Chalona telitaa, ikre chalon choshna, uveh nafka kochava chada, veikre nigha devusina, (nusach acher dabevatzeyney) hay ihu netzitzu denatzitz, vekayyeyma al kol rucha, venayycha veshezvuta (nusach acher vetivuta) beh. let beh kitruga kelal, kad ihu shalta, kol nayycha, vechol nehiru shalta bealma, shalva sava vecholla shallit bealma.

Chalona reviaa, ihu chalon deikre gevia, uveh nafka kochava chad, deikre lechakkimin eshkol hakkofer, begin dehachi nafik keeshkol, natzitz netzitzin kaanavin bekofara, behay ittearu derachame ittear bealma, marchik umakriv, toladin saggiin asgiu bealma. bene alma la kafde kad itzterichu da leda, shelama vechedva ittear bealma.

Chalona chamishaa, ihu chalon deikre beer, al di kochava denafik beh, al venafik shaiv kaddeli, la shachich lealmin. behay chakkime libba la yachlin lemekam beorach keshot, begin dela kaim bekiyyuma, vela shachich lealmin. veal da itdachakan garmayyhu, leayyeyna behay atar, ulemedan dina.

Chalona shetitaa, ihu chalon deikre nogha, venafka beh kochava chad, deakrin gizron, begin dechad hay shalta, alma kaim bedina, vechamma gizrin, uvechamma onashin, uvechol yoma veyoma mitchaddeshan gizrin al alma, vead la yesayyeymun illen, ha acharanin mitchaddeshin, vehay la shalta kol kach bealma.

Aval samuch leyome meshicha, yishlot hay chalona, behay kochava, al alma. veal da yishletun chevan umarin bishin al alma, veyitchadtun zinin bishin, da batar da, veyisrael yehon beaku. vechad yitdachakun go chashocha degaluta, keden yanher lon kudesha berich hu nehiru dimama, vikabbelun malchuta kaddishe elyonin, veyyitbattel malchuta mida deammin ovde kochavim, veyishletun alayyhu yisrael, veyitkayyem (Yeshayahu 30:26) vehaya or hallevana vegomer.

Ucheden chalona sheviaa yitpetach bechol alma, vechochava dileh ihu kochava deyaakov, vehay ihu dekaamar bilam, (Bamidbar 24:17) darach kochav miyyaakov, vechochava da yehe nahir (nusach acher 4 yomin 10 laylayn) arbein (8 amud alef) yomin. (vearbein laylayn) vechad yitgele malka meshicha, veyitkanneshun legabbe malka meshicha kol ammin dealma, keden yitkayyem kera dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 11:10) soresh yishay asher omed lenes ammim elav goyim yidroshu vehayta menuchato kavod.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar, (Iyov 35:10) velo amar ayye eloah osay noten zemirot ballayla. hay kera ukemuha veittemar, aval osay, osi mibbae leh, man osay. ella shema deeloah shema kalil ihu deitchaze hu uve dineh. da shema shelim ihu, dechalil dechar venukeba: 31 11 uvegini kach osay.
Noten zemirot ballayla, begin deda ihu deka (170 amud alef) meshabbachat tadir legabbe malka dishlama dileh, kegavvna devutzina dela shachich tadir, begin lekabbela nehora chedva illaa, missegiut
843: Chedva dileh. veal da noten zemirot ballayla.

Kol innun kochavaya deka menaharan birkia, kullehu odan umeshabbechan lekudesha berich hu, bechol hahu zimna deitchazun birkia, begin demalache illae, kullehu odan umeshabbechan ashmurot ashmurot, bitlat palge dehavy lelya.

Belelya itpalgan kamma sitrin. bereshita delelya, kad ramash lelya veitchashach, kol innun ruchin bishin vezinin bishin, kullehu mitbadderan vemshatte bechol alma. veitparshat sitra achara, vetave arche deve malka, mikkol innun sitrin kaddishin.

Kevan dehahu sitra achara ittear, kol bene alma taame taama demota, (nusach acher dasheyneh) chad mishittin bemota, veshalta alayyhu. keden kevan dimsoovu itparsha milleella, veshalta venachta letatta, keden itparshan telat mashshiryayn leshabbecha leh lekudesha berich hu, bitlat sitrin (nusach acher matrin) delelya, kema deitaru behay chavraya.
Beod deinnun meshabbechin lekudesha berich hu, sitra achara azla umeshatteta letatta, bechol sitre alma, vead desitra achara la itabbar mittamman, la yachlin innun leityaychada bemarehon.

Raza lechakkimin, malache elyonin, veyisrael letatta, kullehu dachake behahu sitra achara. malachin illain kad baan leityaychada bemarehon, la yachlin ad dedachyayn lah levar. ma avdin, nachtin shittin ribbo demalache kaddishe, vaafillu shenata al kol bene alma, kevan deihi nachta, deka dachyyayn lah levar, veyahave lah kol alma da behahi shenata, keden ihi shalta alayyhu, umekabbelin misavu minnah. bar beara deyisrael bilchodaha, dela (140 amud bet) shalta tamman. kevan deihi itparsha minnayyhu, alin lekame marihon, umeshabbechan veodan kameh.

Kegavvna da yisrael letatta, la yachlin leityaychada bemarehon, ad dedachyayn lehahu sitra achara minnayyhu, veyahave lah chulaka bemma deitaskat, ulevatar, innun mitkarve legabbe marehon, vela ishtechach mekatrega ella vetatta.

Vei tema tinach letatta, aval leella may kitruga tamman. ella leella, begin deihu ruach mesaava, veinnun ruchin kaddishin, ad dimshaddere rucha mesaava mibbenayyhu, la yachlin lekarva legabbe marehon, deha kudesha go mesaava, la mitarev lealmin. vechen kegavvna da, yisrael letatta, la mitarvin beumin ovde kochavim umazzalot dealma. uteren sitrin, illain vetattain, kad bayayn lekarva legabbe malka kaddisha, dachyyayn lah levar.

Veal da, kad ayiyil lelya, umalachin kaddishin illain, kad mistadderan shurin shurin lekarva (nusach acher leshabbecha) legabbe marihon, dachyyayn leh lehahu sitra levar bekadmita, ulevatar alin bekudesha. (nusach acher veal da, kad ayiyil lelya kol ruchin bishin vezinin bishin veruchi misave itdachyayn lakkar veshimshay malka ayylin lego kudsha).

Lemalka, dahavo leh avanin yakirin bechad tevuta, mitgallefa bekusetroy. vehahu malka hava chakkim. begin dela yitkarev kol man devae, legabbe hahu tevuta daavanin yakiran umargelan detamman, natal bechachmateh, chad chivya takkifa, vekarich leh sacharaneh dehahu tevuta, kol man devae leoshata yedeh legabbe tevuta, ha chivya dalig aleh, vekatil leh.

Chad rechima hava lemalka, amar leh malka, kol zimna deat bae leaala uleishtammesha betevuta, taavid kach vechach legabbe hahu chivya, vetiftach tevuta, uteshammesh bignizin dili. kach kudesha berich hu, karich chivya sacharanih dekudsha, atan malachin illain leaala go kudsha, ha chivya tamman, vedachale leistaava beh. (vei tema ze akkulehu eshsha, vaessa lo mekabbela misava)

Ta chaze, ketiv (Tehillim 104:4) ose malachav ruchot meshartav esh lohet, ose malachav ruchot, illen malachin dekayymin levar. meshartav esh lohet, illen malachin dekayymin lego, ihu rucha misavu, veinnun ruach. ruach beruach la ayiyil da beda. ruach misavu beruach kudsha la
844: Itarve da beda. ubbegin kach innun deikrun ruach, la yachlin leaala lego, begin hahu rucha misavu. innun dilgo, innun esh, vehahu esh dache lehahu misavu dela ayel lego. ubbegin kach kolla dachyyayn leh levar lemisavu, dela yitarav bahadayyhu. veal da, malache illae ka meshabbechan leh lekudesha berich hu, batar dedachyayn leh lemisavu levar.

Telat ashmurot innun belelya, lokovlehon telat mashshiryayn, deka mitpallege leshabbecha lekudesha berich hu, kema deittemar. veal da hay ribbon dechullehu, ihu nir (nusach acher kaynaver) dedavid dela shachich lealmin, ella tadir ode umeshabbach leh lemalka illaa, veal da (Iyov 35:10) noten zemirot ballayla.

Davar acher, velo amar ayye eloah osay, kema deittemar, begin deha meella umittatta itkelil bar nash, veitavid, kema deihu gufa mitteren sitrin, miggo dechar venukeba, uf hachi rucha. ruach ihu kalil, miggo dechar venukeba. veal raza dena ittakkan bar nash biglifoy, begufa verucha. uvegin deihu kalil beraza da, uveovada da, kema deittemar, al da (vadday) ketiv, (Bereshit 1:26) vayyomer elohim naase adam betzalmenu kidmutenu veha ittemar.

Belelya ha amart, deha bereshita delelya, kol innun zinin veruchin bishin mitare bealma, hech ihu yachil lemeheve, dei hachi, ha tanenan, demistera detzafon nafke kol hane zinin bishin, veitteamrat (sefer acher veittemar) dechad ittear ruach tzafon befalgut lelya, deha keden kol innun ruchin bishin, vesitrin bishin, itkenashu mealma, vealin go nukeba dithoma rabba, i hachi ha besitra dedarom deihu yemina, amay meshatte innun zinin bishin beresh lelya, deka shalta ruach darom.

Ella vadday, ilmale hahu sitra dedarom, deka meakkev vedachyay lehahu sitra bisha, hava mitashtesh kule alma, vela yachil alma lemisbal. aval kad ittear hahu sitra achara, la ittear ella bistar ruach maarav, deka shalta beresh lelya, vealma ihu kolla kanish. veal da kudesha berich hu akdim asvavta lealma, begavvna da kema deittemar. zakkain innun yisrael behay alma uvealma deate dekudesha berich hu itree behu mikkol shear ammin dealma.

Alu leveta rabbi elazar verabbi abba. kad itpelag lelya, kamu lemile beorayyta. amar rabbi abba, hasheta vadday ihu iddan reuta lekudesha berich hu, veha zimnin saggiin ittearna hay, dekudesha berich hu beshaata deitpelag lelya, al go innun tzaddikayyay beginta deeden, veishtaasha behu. zakkaa ihu man deishtaddal beorayyta, behahi zimna.

Amar rabbi elazar, ha deishtaasha kudesha berich hu go tzaddikayya beginta deeden, hech ishtasha. ella behahu zimna deitpelag lelya, kudesha berich hu ittear birchimu dismala, legabbe keneset yisrael, deha let rechimu ella missitra dismala. uchenset yisrael leh lah dorona lemikrav legabbe malka, o chashivu mealya, ella beinnun ruchin detzaddikayya, dekudesha berich hu chame lon mitatteran, bechamma ovadin tavin, uvechamma zachyayn deavdu behahu yoma, vekudesha berich hu nicha leh mikkol karbanin veillavavn, dekudesha berich hu arach behu reach nichoach, deka avde yisrael.

Keden nehiru itnehir, vechol ilanin deginta deeden amru shirata, vetzaddikayya mitatteran tamman beinnun iddunin dealma deate. kad ittear bar nash behahi shaata lemile beorayyta, natil chulakeh immehon detzaddikayya di bego ginta, chad shema gelifa ditlatin uteren atvavn, (sefer acher ittear) itattar behu tamman, veihu go razin detzaddikayya.

Patach rabbi elazar veamar, (Tehillim 111:1) haleluyah ode Adonai bechol levav vegomer, haleluyah, ha ittemar veittearu beh chavrayyay, vehachi ihu, deda ihu shevacha deka salleka al kol innun shirin vetushebchan deamar david, beeser zini tushebchan deihu amar, begin deihu kalil shema (vayyishlach 172 amud bet) ushevacha bechad, veihu kelala dishma kaddisha illaa.
Ode Adonai bechol levav, bechol atar deamar david malka, raza dealfa
845: Beta, ihu raza deatvavn gelifan, denafkin begillufe ditlatin uteren shevilin. veit atvavn illain, meraza dealma illaa. veit atvavn acharanin, deinnun atvavn (hakedama 3 amud alef) zeirin. vehacha ihu raza dealfa beta, dealma (sefer acher ilaa yahiv lealma) tattaa.

Ode Adonai bechol levav: beyyitzra tava uveyyitzra bisha deihu share begavveh. deha al kolla it leodaa leh lekudesha berich hu, beyyitzra tava uveyyitzra bisha. deha missitra deyitzra tava ate tov levar nash, veit levarcha leh lekudesha berich hu hattov vehametiv. uvesitra deyitzra bisha, ate kitruga levar nash, veit leodaa lekudesha berich hu, (beyitzra tava vabeytzeraa bisha) bechol ma deate al bar nash, missitra da umissitra da.

Besod yesharim veeda, besod yesharim: beinnun (sefer acher malachin illain kaddishin) deraza dekudesha berich hu innun yade. deha kol razin dekudesha berich hu innun yade, veinnun raza dileh, veal da besod yesharim. veeda: illen innun yisrael, kad mitkanneshe baasara, leodaa leh lekudesha berich hu, ubbegin kach, it leodaa leh lekudesha berich hu, al tav veal bish, ulefarsema kame kolla. dei tema ha ihu yada, amay itzterich lefarsema. ella beda, ityaykar kudesha berich hu bealma lefarsema nissa. veal da kudesha berich hu ketiv beh, (Yechezkel 38:23) vehitgaddilti vehitkaddishti vegomer.

Rabbi yehuda patach veamar, (Tehillim 150:6) kol hanneshama tehallel yah. tanna, kol nishmatin atu mehay gufa kaddisha, veataru bivne nasha. umean atar. mehahu atar deikre yad. (sefer acher 15) man atar da amar rabbi yehuda dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:24) ma rabbu maasecha Adonai kullam bechachma asita. tana, mehay chachmeta demabbuoy nafkin litlatin uteren shevilin, ishtachlal kolla, vechol ma deit leella vetatta, vehu itkere rucha kaddisha, dechol ruchin ishtachlalu beh.
Amar rabbi yitzchak, beyoma dehava rabbi shimon parish milla da, enoy navin mayya, vahava amar, kol ginzayyay demalka illaa, itmasran bechad maftecha, veitgalyay bekuzfitan dekuredite gelifin illain.

Ella hachi tana, man yachil leishtemoda uleitkalla ma deganiz beda mabbua. deha moshe la galle da beyomoy, kad hava galle raza amikta leyisrael, veaf al gav dechola hava mitgalyay al yedoy. ella behahi shaata devaa kudesha berich hu lesalleka leh limtivta kaddisha illaa, uletamra leh mibbene nasha, dichtiv, (Devarim 31:2) ben mea veesrim shana anochi hayyom. hayyom mammash, dehahu yoma ishtelimu yomoy, leitkarva leatar da, dichtiv, (Devarim 31:14) hen karvu yamecha, karvu mammash.

Detanya amar rabbi shimon, moshe la mit. vei tema ha ketiv (Devarim lo) vayyamat sham moshe. kach bechol atar letzaddikayya kare behu mita. may mita. missitra dilan ikre hachi. detanya amar rabbi shimon, vechen tana, deman deihu bishlimuta dimhemnuta kaddisha talyay beh, la talyay beh mita vela mit. kema dehava beyaakov dimhemnuta shelemata hava beh.

Deamar ribbi shimon, (Bereshit 35:10) lo yikkare shimcha od yaakov ki im yisrael yihye shemecha, vayyikra et shemo yisrael. may yisrael. shelemuta decholla. dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 30:10) veatta al tira avdi yaakov veal techat yisrael ki hinni moshiacha merachok veet zaracha meeretz shivyam vegomer.
Amar ribbi yehuda mehacha, (Yirmeyahu 30:11) ki ittecha ani, dayyka, zakkaa chulekeh, demareh amar leh ken. ki itti atta la ketiv, ella ki ittecha ani, demareh ate leitchabbera diyyureh immeh.

Amar rabbi shimon shappir kaamar ribbi abba deamar (Yirmeyahu 30:10) veshav yaakov veshakat veshaanan veen macharid. veshav yaakov: leitkere bishma achara, dichtiv lo yikkare shimcha od yaakov ki im yisrael.

Davar acher veshav yaakov, leatar deitnesiv mittamman. veshakat, baolam hazze. veshaanan, baolam habba. veen macharid mimmalach hammavet. demashma decholla hava beh. ribbi yitzchak amar, chavrayyay ha ukemuha, dichtiv veet zaracha meeretz shivyam, ma zaro bachayyim, af hu bachayyim.
846: Vehabberiach hattichon betoch hakkerashim mavriach min hakkatze el hakkatze. rabbi yehuda patach (Kohelet 10:17) (95 amud bet) ashrech eretz shemmalkech ben chorim vesarayich baet yochelu. uchetiv, i lacha eretz shemmalkech naar vesarayich babboker yochelu. (bemay okimna hane kerae) vavy lealma dela mashgechan befulechana demarehon, deha marehon ashgach beginehon leotava lehu, deanach kamayyhu pitgame orayyta, vela mashgechan.

Detanenan, telat millin bae bar nash lemebad livreh, mila, ufidyon, ulenasva leh intu. vecholla avid kudesha berich hu leyisrael. mila: dichtiv, (Yehoshua Adonai:2) veshuv mol et beni yisrael shenit. uchetiv (Bereshit 17:12) uven shemonat yamim yimmol lachem kol zachar. pidyon. dichtiv, (Devarim 15) vayyifdecha (Adonai elohecha) (sefer acher 4 mibbet avadim) miyyad paro melech mitzrayim. lenasseva leh intu: dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:28) zachar unekeva bara otam, uchetiv vayvarech otam elohim vayyomer lahem elohim peru urevu. tu, attil lehu kehay nishra, deatil livnoy al gadpoy, dichtiv, (Shemot 19:4) vaessa etchem al kanfe nesharim.

Amar rabbi yosi, kolla hu yeot, aval orayyta deahadar kamayyhu deyisrael, veolif lon, yattir mikkolla. ta chazi, let shevacha devar nash behay alma uvealma deate, kishvacha deorayyta dichtiv bah (Mishlei 5) bi melachim yimlochu.

(Midrash hannelam hu) deha tanenan kad salik rav huna lehatam, ashkach rabbanan dahavo aske behay kera, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 51:44) ufakadti al bel bevavel vehotzeti et bilo mippiv velo yinharu elav od goyim. verav huna la havo mashgichin beh, deha la ishtemodan leh bekadmita, begin dehava zeer. al leve midrasha, veashkach rabbanan dahavo amre, hay kera it leistakkela beh, i taavateh vedachalteh dinvuchadnetzar hava shemeh bel, ha ketiv beh, (Daniel 4:Adonai) vead ochorin al kodamay daniel di sheme belteshatztzar keshum elahi. veod, may vehotzeti et bilo mippiv.

Kam rav huna bene kayayme deamude, veamar illu havena beatri, darishna leh lehay pesuka. la ashgachu beh. kam tinyaynut, veamar milla da. ata rabbi yoday bar rav, veotveh kammeh. amar leh, ema beri ema, demille orayyta ketiv behu, (Mishlei 1:21) berosh homiyyot tikra vegomer.

Patach veamar, hachi tanenan, beyome kadmae ad la ata yaakov, hava bar nash shalev beveteh, mata zimneh, mit bela marin, kevan deata yaakov, baa kameh dekudesha berich hu, amar leh, mare dealma, i nicha kamach, delinpol bar nash beve mareh, teren o telat yomin, ulevatar yitkenash leammeh, veyafked leveteh, veyetuv mechovoy. amar leh shappir. at hu simana bealma. ta chaze, ma ketiv beh (Bereshit 48:1) vayhi achare haddevarim haelle vayyomer leyosef hinne avicha chole. chole ketiv ma dela hava levar nash min kadmat dena.

Batar deshachiv, la hava bar nash dehava leh marin, dela mit. ad deata chizkiyya, ma ketiv beh, (Yeshayahu 38:1) bayyamim hahem chala chizkiyyahu lamut vegomer. ta chazi, ma ketiv vayassev chizkiyyahu panav el hakkir vayyitpallel el Adonai, amar leh, i nicha kamach deyittesun bene nasha mibbe marehon, veyodun shemach, veyishtemodun, vituvun levatar betiyyuveta shelemata, veyishtakkechun bene alma zakkain kodamach. amar leh kudesha berich hu, yeot hu, att tehe simana bealma, vechach hu, may dela hava mikkadmat dena. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 38:9) michtav lechizkiyyahu melech yehuda bachaloto vaychi mechalyo. vetana, hahu yoma itchazar shimsha eser dargin.

Vetana, merodach baladan hava achil kol yoma bed shate, venaim ad tesha shate, vehahu yoma naim ad 9 shate, kad ittear chama shimsha dekaim bed shate, amar may hay, bekittula dekunetira konteroy ankattartun. amru
847: Leh lamma. amar, denaimna yoma chad, utelatut yoma. amru leh, lav hachi, ella elaha dechizkiya avad yoma den teren nissin. ase lechizkiya mibbe mareh, veachzar shimsha leiddana da. amar vechi it bealma elaha rabba bar meelahay. amru, elaha dechizzekiyahu.

Kam vechatav ketavoy, shelam lechizkiyyahu malka dihuda ushelam leelaheh ushelam liyrushala 40 karta kaddisha. levatar amlich vekam mikkurseya, ufasa telat pesian, vechatav acharanin, shelam leelaha rabba deviyrushala 40 ushelam lechizkiyyahu malka dihuda ushelam liyrushala 40 karta kaddisha. amar leh kudesha berich hu, ant pasat begin yekari telat pesian, chayyecha, minach yifkun telat malkin shallitin, kastirin rufinin deshalitin bechol alma, vekadmaa minnayyhu nevuchadnetzar hava.

Ta chaze, may amar leh daniel, (Daniel 2:38-39) annet hu resha di dahava. uvatrach tekum malchu ochori ara minach umalchu telitaa ochori vegomer. ma ketiv (Daniel 3:1) nevuchadnetzar malka avad tzelem di dehav rumeh ammin shittin petaye ammin shit. amar nevuchadnetzar tzulma dachamena, hava resha di dahava, meoy dechesef, ana aavid kolla dedahava, delihve kazpira dedahava beresha.

Vetana, hahu yoma kanash kol umayya vaamamya velishanayay lemiflach lehahu tzalma, venatal mana mimmani makdesha, dehava galif beh shema kaddisha, veayil leh befumeh dehahu tzalma, uvehahi shaata hava memallel ravrevan, ad deata daniel, vekariv gabbe dehahu tzalma, veamar ana shelicha demara illaa, gozrani alach lemefak mehacha. idkar shema kaddisha, venafak hahu mana, venafal tzalma veitbar. hayeynu dichtiv vehotzeti et bilo mippiv velo yinharu elav od goyim. kam ribbi yehuda unashkeh al resheh, amar i la dekarivna bekkutefayay hacha, la ishtemodana bach. vahavu dachalin kammeh mehahu yoma.

Tana (kahelatey) ashrech eretz shemmalkech ben chorim vesarayich baet yochelu. ribbi yosi okim lehay kera, bemoshe, beshaata deappik lehu leyisrael mimmitzrayim, vaavad lon beni chorin. vesarayich baet ychelu, dichtiv, (Shemot 12:11) veachaltem oto bechippazon pesach hu laAdonai.

Amar ribbi shimon bar yochay, vechi la amena demiloy dishlomo malka, dechullehu bego, lego hechla kaddisha havo. vehay deamrittu kolla shappir hava, velidrasha hu deata, aval hay kera, leella behechala kaddisha hu.

Tana, ashrech eretz shemmalkech ben chorim. may eretz. eretz setam. detanya, mahu dichtiv, (Eicha 2:1) hishlich mishshamayim eretz tiferet yisrael. ella hay eretz, hi raza, bego kitre malka kaddisha, dichtiv beh (Bereshit 2:4) beyom asot Adonai elohim eretz veshamayim. vehay eretz, vechol ma deyanik veittezan, mehahu atar deikre shamayim hu, vela ittezanat ara da, ella mishshelemuta kaddisha, deikre shamayim.

Uveshaata devaa kudesha berich hu leacharava beteh diltatta, veara kaddisha diltatta, abar lehay ara kaddisha dilella bekadmita, venachit leh mehahu darga dehava yanka mishshamayim kaddisha, ulevatar chariv lehay diltatta, hada hu dichtiv hishlich mishshamayim eretz bekadmita, ulevatar vela zachar hadom raglav. detanya, kach archoy dekudesha berich hu, kad bae lemedan alma, bekadmita avid dina leella, ulevatar itkayyaym letatta, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 24:21) yifkod Adonai al tzeva hammarom bammarom, bekadmita, ulevatar veal malche haadama al haadama.

Amar ribbi shimon, ashrech eretz shemmalkech ben chorin, dezan lach bisgiut kolla, bela dechilu deachara, umehahu malka illaa ittezan kolla. vesarayich baet ychelu, kema deat amer (Bamidbar 23:23) kaet yeamer leyaakov uleyisrael ma paal el, i lach eretz shemmalkech naar kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 3:4) venatatti nearim sarehem. devavy leara kad yanka missemala. vesarayich babboker yochelu,
848: Behahu kadruta, vead la nahir, vela shalta ma deshalta.

Tana amar rabbi shimon, (Shemot 26:28) vehabberiach hattichon betoch hakkerashim mavriach min hakkatze el hakkatze, da hu yaakov kaddisha shelema, kema deukimna, dichtiv, (Bereshit 25:27) veyaakov ish tam yoshev ohalim. yoshev ohel la ketiv, ella yoshev ohalim, tere, deachid lehay veachid lehay. af hacha ketiv, vehabberiach hattichon betoch hakkerashim, mavriach min hakkatze el hakkatze, deachid lehay veachid lehay.
Detanenan, may ish tam. ketargumo, shelim. shelim mikkolla, shelim litren sitrin, leattika kaddisha, velizer appin. shelim lechesed illaa veliggevura illaa, veashlim lehay ulehay.

Amar ribbi shimon, chamena deha chachmeta kelal kolla. vechesed illaa nafka mechachma. gevura, dehu dina takkifa, nafka mibbina. yaakov ashlim litren sitrin vaavahan kelal kolla, veyaakov kelal avahata.

Tana batash chachma bishviloy, vechanif berucha (sefer acher 81) veitkanfu mayya leatar chad, veitpetachu chamshin tarin devina. meillen shevilin, nafke asara kitrin, bekarnitte zehirin, veishtaaru esrin uteren shevilin. batash hahu rucha beinnun shevilin, veitpetachu chamshin tarin devina, veitgelifu esrin uteren, bechamshin tarin deyovla, veitattaru beshivin uteren atvavn dishma kaddisha. illen itpetachu lesitroy.

Veitattaru esrin uteren kitrin derachame, dichlilan beattik yomin, denahir lon kol chad besitroy. itattaru chamshin gelifin, bemv atvavn kaddishin dishma kaddisha, divhon itbere shemaya veara. veitgelafu begilufehon, temmanya tarin, deinnun temanya atvavn derachame, dichtiv, (Shemot la) Adonai Adonai el rachum vechannun, denafka meattika kaddisha, lizira, umitchabberan beillen kitrin kaddishin, chachma uvina illain desallekin. nafka chesed illaa mehay sitra, vedina digvura mehay sitra, ata zechuta deyaakov, veashlim atarvavyyhu veachid lon. deha hu shelemuta illaa.

Tana amar ribbi shimon, begin kach yisrael itkere. detana yaakov tattaa. yisrael illaa. yaakov lav shelemuta, yisrael shelemuta decholla. vechen tana, (Shmuel 2 23:1) neum david ben yishay, david lav shelemuta, deha batraa hu. yishay yesod illaa hu, ushelemuta. vehayeynu detanenan, la galu yisrael meartzam ad shekkafru bekudesha berich hu, uvemalchuta devet david, dichtiv, (Shmuel 2 20:1) en lanu chelek bedavid velo nachala beven yishay ish leohalav yisrael. may ish leohalav. atar deavodat kochavim umazzalot sharya begavvayyhu, hayeynu leelohav.

Amar ribbi yehuda, kad sharya chachmeta legalfa gelifin bechullehu kitrin, mean kitra shaare mehahu deitkere bina. bebina itkelil kolla. ubbegin kach itpetachu bah chamshin tarin, veishtechach decholla bechachma itgelafu, hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:24) kullam bechachma asita.

Tana, ketiv (Yeshayahu 40:12) mi madad beshoolo mayim vegomer. beshoolo mayim. man mayim. da hu bina. ribbi elazar matni hachi, da chesed. amar leh rabbi shimon, kolla bechad matkela salleka. (sefer acher mittakken) (Yeshayahu 40:12) veshamayim bazzeret tikken, man shamayim. tiferet. dichtiv tiferet yisrael. vechol bashshalish afar haaretz. da hu gevura. veshakal bappeles harim, illen innun shear kitrin, deikrun ture afarsemona dachya. uggevaot bemoznayim, illen shear retichin tattain minnayyhu.
Ta chazi, beshoolo, may shoolo. da ruach chachmeta dehachi tanenan, shoola dekitre bekizfa shekian.

Veshamayim bazzeret tikken, man zeret. illen innun (chamshin) tarin deitpatachu veitpazru lechol sitrin, kema deat amer (Malachi 2:3) vezeriti feresh al penechem vegomer. vechol bashshalish, man shalish. rachame. shelemuta decholla. veshakal bappeles, may peles, amar ribbi shimon, dichtiv, (Vayikra 19:36) mozne tzedek. avne tzedek. tu amar rabbi shimon, hane mille beshiura
849: Amar rabbi elazar, shema minnah, deyaakov miggo dina kashya nafik, deha yitzchak dina kashya, achid lechulakeh. amar leh ribbi shimon, veda hu bilchodoy, veha yitzchak miggo chesed nefak, vehachi kullehu, dina miggo rachame nafka, verachame middina. avraham yarit achasana dechesed, nafak yitzchak bedina miggo chesed. yaakov nefak berachame, miggo dina kashya, vechach hu leella, da min da, veyanka da min da, ad deishtemoda kolla dehu chad, umechad talyayn kullehu, vecholla ishtechach chad. berich shemeh lealam ulealme almin.

Amar rabbi elazar, ishtemoda, delet shelemuta ella kad achid da min da, (sefer acher vechad) veda achid betarvavyyhu, leshachlela kolla, kegon yaakov, vehayeynu dichtiv mavriach min hakkatze el hakkatze.

Tana, kule hay la itkere ella missitra dilan, umissitra dilan ishtemoda kolla. (sefer acher deha behay leella) uleella kolla bechad matkela salleka. la shani, vela yishtani, kema dichtiv, (Malachi 3:6) ani Adonai la shaniti. amar rabbi yehuda, kullehon butzinin nehirin mechad, umechad talyayn, uvutzinin inhu chad kolla. deha la bau leitparsha, uman defarish lon, keillu itperash min chayye alma.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, ketiv (Yeshayahu 3:4) venatatti nearim sarehem vetaalulim yimshelu vam, hayeynu dichtiv, (Shemot 25:18) veasita shenayim keruvim zahav. ketiv (Shmuel 1 4:4) yoshev hakkeruvim, uchetiv (Shmuel 2 22:11) vayyirkav al keruv vayyaof. yoshev hakkeruvim, kad sharya leityayshsheva bishlimuta, ketiv yoshev hakkeruvim. (sefer acher kad ishtechach bishlemuta) vechad la sharya, vela ityayshva malka bechurseya, ketiv vayyirkav al keruv chad, dela ityayshva malka bechurseyyay. yoshev hakkeruvim tere.

Amar rabbi yosi, vavy lealma, kad chad keruv ahdar anpe mechavreh, deha ketiv ufenehem ish el echav, kad hava shelama bealma. amar rabbi yitzchak, ha tanenan (Vayikra 18:7) ervat avicha veervat immecha lo tegalle, vavy leman degalle arayaython. kegavvna da ketiv beyaakov, mavriach min hakkatze el hakkatze. zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael, dekudesha berich hu mishtebach betushbachatayyhu kegavvna dilella, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 49:3) yisrael asher becha etpaar.

Tana amar rabbi yitzchak, beyome kadmae, hava bar nash amar lechavreh, ema li milla chada deorayyta, vetol mane kesaf. hasheta amar bar nash lechavreh, tol mane kesaf veishtedal beorayyta, velet man deyishgach, velet man deyarkin udeneh, bar innun zeirin (nusach acher zarin) kaddishe elyonin, dekudesha berich hu mishtebach behu, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 60:21) veammech kullam tzaddikim leolam yirshu eretz netzer mattaay maase yaday lehitpaer.

(Shemot 27:10) vavi haammudim vachashukehem kasef. rabbi yitzchak amar, vavi haammudim, ha amena kol innun demitachadan mikkitre kayyaymin illain, ikrun vavi haammudim. vechol innun diltatta, talyayn meinnun vavim. may vvim. shita bego shita, umitachadan umitshakyayn michuta deshidra, dekaim alayyhu. uvesifra ditzniuta tana, vavim leella, vavim letatta, vechullehu bematkela chad sallekin.
850: Hahu data meidune alma la yada veitavidu minneh. kach, man denakit kelala, vela yada bechullehu idunin dimhanyayn, denafkin mehahu kelala.

Sifra ditzniuta pirka kadmaa tana. sifra detzniuta, sifra, deshakil (235 amud alef) bematkela. (tana) dead dela hava matkela, la havo mashgichin appin beappin, umalchin kadmain mitu, veziunehon la ishtakkechu, veara itbattelat.
Ad deresha dechissufa dechol kisufin, levushe dikar atkin, veachasin.
Hay matkela tale baatar dela hava, ittekalu beh innun dela ishtakkechu. matkela kaim begufeh. la itachad, vela itchaze. beh seliku, uveh salkin dela havo, vahavu, veyhvyyayn.

Sitra go sitra, ittekkan vizdeman, (205 128 amud bet, 14 287, 288 amud alef) bechad gulegalta, malyay talla divdolcha. (sham 205 129) keruma deavvira izdachach vesatim, innun amar neke talyayn beshshikula. raava (12 sham) deraavin itgalya bitzlota detattae. ashgacha pekicha dela naim, venatir tedira. ashgachuta detatta beashgachuta dinhiru deillaa. (deveh) terin nukevin defardaska, deittear rucha lecholla.

Bereshit bara elohim et hashshamayim veet haaretz, shita bereshit (bara shit) alayyhu, kulehu letatta, vetalyayn mishshiva deguleglata ad yekiru deyakiruta, vehaaretz tinyayna lav bechusheban veha ittemar. umehahi deitlatteyay nafka, dechtiv (Bereshit Adonai:29) min haadama asher erara Adonai. hayta tohu vavohu vechoshech al pene tehom veruach elohim merachefet al pene hammayim. telesar, talyayn bitlesar yekiru deyakiruta.

Shita alfe shenin, talyayn beshita kadmae, sheviaa alayyhu, deittakkaf bilchodoy. veitchariv kolla bitresar shate, dechtiv hayta tohu vavohu vegomer. telesar yekim lon berachame, umitchaddeshan bekadmita, vekamu (70 146) kol innun shita. begin dechtiv bara, ulevatar ketiv hayta, deha havat vadday, ulevassof tohu vavohu vechoshech, (Yeshayahu 2:11) venisgav Adonai levaddo beyom hahu.

Gilufe diglifin kechezu dechivya arich, umitpashshat lechan ulechan, zanva beresha. resha (achora) achid achatfin, abar vezaim, netar veganiz. chad leelef yomin zeirin itgalyay, (nusach acher itmalleyay) kuletra bekitroy, senappira beadvoy, itbar resheh bemayin deyamma rabba, dechtiv (Tehillim 74:13) shibbarta rashe tanninim al hammayim. teren havo, chad itchazare, (34 amud bet) tanninam ketiv chaser. rashe, kema deat amer (Yechezkel 1:22) udemut al rashe hachayya rakia.

Vayyomer elohim yehi or vayhi or, hayeynu dechtiv (tehillim log) ki hu amar vayyehi, hu bilchodoy. levatar itchazru chad 31 Yahu 16 6 batraa shechinta letatta. kema de shechinta ishtechach uvechad matkela ittekalu.

Vehachayyot ratzo vashov, dechtiv vayyar elohim et haor ki tov. (Yeshayahu 3:10) imru tzaddik ki tov. hay, bematkelle salleka. kadmaa bilchodoy. vecholla lechad itchazre. achata umodata kelilan da beda beYod hei, kitren rechimin demitchabbekan.

Shita nafkin meanfa desharsha degufa, lishan memallel ravrevan. lishan da, satim ben yod vehe, dechtiv (Yeshayahu 44:5) ze yomar laAdonai ani veze yikra beshem yaakov veze yichtov yado laAdonai uveshem yisrael yechanne (yechunne) mammash. ze yomar laAdonai ani: achata. vecholla ittemar beyhv. kolla kelilan belishan satim leima. deha itpattechat leh denafik minnah. abba yativ beresha, ima beemtzaita, umitkasyyay mikkan umikkan vavy leman degalle arayaython.

Vayyomer elohim yehi meorot birkia hashshamayim, shallit dechar benukeva. Amar ribbi yitzchak, nehora illaa, unehora tattaa kalil kachada, ikre (138 amud bet) veatta. kema deat amar (Nechemya 9:6) veatta mechayye et kullam. veal da la ketiv, vehikravta et aharon achich. vetzivita et bene yisrael. vedibbarta el kol chachme lev. begin dehahu zimna sharya shimsha besihara, veishtattaf kolla kachada, lesharya al umanuta deovada. amar ribbi elazar, mehacha, (Shemot 36:1) asher natan Adonai chachma utevuna bahemma.

Ribbi shimon amar mehacha, veatta tedabber el kol chachme lev asher milletiv ruach chachma. asher milletim mibbae leh. ella asher milletiv, lehahu libba, milletiv ruach chachma. kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 11:2) venacha alav ruach Adonai ruach chachma vegomer veal da itzterich asher milletiv ruach chachma, desharya shimsha besihara beashlemuta decholla, veal da itreshim kolla vechol atar. amar ribbi elazar, i hachi hane veatta veatta, heach mityayshshevan bikrae.

Amar leh, kullehu mityayshshevan ninhu. veatta hakkerev elecha: leyachada bahadeh, ulekarva bahadeh, raza dishma kadisha kedka yeot. veatta tedabber el kol chachme lev: begin dechullehu la atyayn lemebad avidta, ad deruach kudsha memallela begavvavyyhu, velachash lon bilchishu, ucheden avde avidta. veatta tetzavve et beni yisrael: ruach kudsha pakda alayyhu, veanhir alayyhu, lemebad ovada biruta shelim. veatta kach lecha: kema deokimna. (dichtiv) veatta hakerev elecha, vehani kullehu, hacha beovada demashkena. decholla itavid beraza da.

Patach rabbi shimon veamar (Tehillim 22:20) veatta Adonai al tirchak eyaluti leezrati chusha. veatta Adonai kolla chad. al tirchak: leistalleka minan, lemeheve salik nehora illaa mittattaa. deha kad istallak nehora illaa mittattaa, keden itchashach kol nehora, vela ishtechach kelal bealma.

Veal da itcharav be makdesha beyomoy deyirmeyahu. veaf al gav deitbene levatar, la ahdar nehora leatreh kadka yeot. veal raza da, shema dehahu nevia deitnabbe al da, yirmeyahu. istalkuta dinhora illaa, deistallak leela leella, vela ahdar leanhara levatar kedka yeot. yirmeyahu: istallak vela ahdar leatreh, veitcharav be makdesha veitchashachu nehorin.

Aval yeshayahu, shema garim lefurekana, uleahdara nehora illaa leatrih, (Yeshayahu leanhara hahu nehora illaa ulemebad purekana) ulemivne be makdesha, vechol tavin vechol nehorin, yahadrun kedibbekadmeta. veal da, shemahan ditren neviin illen, kayymin da lokovel da, begin dishma garim, vetzerufa deatvavn da beda, garmin ovada, hen letav vehen levish. veal raza da, tzerufa deatvavn dishmahan kaddishin, vechen atvavn begarmayyhu, garmin leitchazaa razin illain, kegavvna dishma kaddisha, deatvavn begarmayyhu, garmin razin illain kaddishin leitchazaa behu.
857: Dekayyeyma al tesha samchin desamchin lah. veinnun kayymin learba sitre alma. kema desofa demachashava, nekuda batraa, kayyeyma learba sitre alma. bar dehay dechar, veihi nukeba.

Vehay kayyeyma bela gufa, vechad kayyeyma bilvusha, deitlabbash behu, ihi kayyeyma al tesha samchin, beraza deat 40 bela iggula. veaf al gav deat 60 ihi beiggula, vekayyeyma beiggula. aval beraza deatvavn chakikin, go nekude, tehirin leella, innun beribbua, diltatta ihu beiggula.

Hay beribbua ihi kayyeyma beshiura detesha nekudin, telat telat lechol setar. veinnun beshiura dechushebana temmanya nekudin, veinnun tesha. veillen innun dekayymin meraza devutzina beribbua besamchin tisha leat yod, nekuda chada. innun tisha. innun temanya beraza deat 40 beribbua, kegavvna da:: telat telat lechol setar

Veda ihu raza : deat yod nekuda chada, veaf al gav deihi nekuda chada, diyyukena dilah, resha leella, vekotza letatta, veshiura dilah telat nekudin kegavvna da veal da itpashtuta learba sitrin, telat, telat lechol setar ihi tesha veihi temanya.
Veillen innun samchin denafkin meraza devutzina, lemehve samchin leat yod, veillen ikrun reticha dilah. vela kayyeymin bishma, bar beraza detesha nekudin deorayyta.

Uveraza desifra deadam, itpelagu illen tesha deinnun temanya, betzerufa deatvavn dishma kaddisha, letzarfa lon uleyachada lon vechol innun gavvnin, kad natlin illen temanya deinnun tesha, naharin binhiru deat 40 beribbua, veappik nehorin temanya, (sefer acher temanya itchazun) itchazun veatvavn tisha. veitpalgan letatta lenatla kol mashkena.

Veinnun tzerufa dishma kaddisha, beraza deshivin uteren atvavn mechakkekan, denafke meraza ditlat gavvnin, yemina usemala veemtzaita. vecholla meraza ditlat nekudin, shiura deat yod, deihi led sitrin, veinnun temanya nekudin, veinnun tesha nekudin, veinnun teresar nekudin illain. 3 3 lechol setar usetar, umehacha nachtin letatta bitresar leshit sitrin. vechad itchakkekan teresar illen beshit sitrin, innun shivin uteren shemahan, raza dishma kaddisha deshivin uteren deinnun shema da kaddisha.

Vecholla ihu salik biruta, dismichu demachashava beinnun samchin deat yod, veal da atvavn betzirufayyeyhu, telat telat vechol tzerufa dileh, begin lesalleka biruta deat 10, ditlat nekudin, kema deittemar, veal da la istelik bisliku detzerufa, ella meikara vesharsha deraza deillen samchin, desamchin leat 10 raza deat 40 beribbua, 9 nekudin, temanya nekudin, teresar nekudin, shivin uteren nekudin. ishtechach, dechol raza dishma kaddisha, kayyeyma beat 10, vecholla raza chada, vekayyeyma beraza devutzina, kema deittemar lemebad semichu lechol at veat. veinnun samchin innun reticha dilhon, dechol at veat, kema deittemar.
Raza tinyayna, at Adonai, dekayyeyma al chamishsha samchin, desamchin lah, denafkin meraza devutzina, kad itkenash leistalleka leella, meraza (204 amud alef) demishchata.
At da hechla kaddisha ikre, lego, nekuda dikamran. vecholla ihu beraza dikamran deat 40 beribbua. aval hacha la itreshim bar at Adonai, ureticha dilah chamishsha samchin dikamran.

Dechad batash nehiru devutzina beat 10, itnehir, umehahu betishuta, itavidu innun tesha (pinchas 283 amud bet, tetze Rosh Chodesh amud alef) samchin dikamran. umiggo nehiru deitnehar at 10, itpeshshatu telat nekudin dey. teren leella, deinnun resha. vechad letatta, deihu kotza dey, kegavvna da dekaamran. kad itpeshshatu, teren, itavidu telat. chad itavid teren. veitpashatu, veitavid chad hechala. da hechala, levatar deitavid hechala lechad nekuda kadmaa,
858: Itavid bignizu tamir raza deat da, vekayyeyma al chamesh acharanin.

Arbea genizin innun, bechad nekuda dekayyeyma lego beemtzaita, innun chamesh. veihi Adonai. kema dehe diltatta, kayyeyma al arba, veihi nekuda al arba, dekayyeyma bego emtzaita. uf hacha name hay. uma dekayyeyma al Adonai samchin, hachi hu vaday, begin dehay nekuda illaa, ihi al teren gavvnin, chad bilchodoy, vechad bitmiru.

Uvesifra derazin dechanoch, Adonai vaday kayyeyma al chamesh samchin denafkin miggo butzina. ucheden appik chamesh kayymin acharanin, veishtechach hay Adonai beraza daasara. vechad itparshat, kayyeyma Adonai da, al samchin, veinnun havo telesar mechilan derachame, bechad darga deittosaf alayyhu.

Veillen innun (180) teresar dekayymin beshit. zimnin innun arbein uteren. zimnin shivin uteren havo, aval (132) nachtin letatta. vehacha itperashu shevilin lechol setar, deinnun telatin uteren, ishtear arbein. uteren udenin yemina usemala, ha arbein uteren, illen 42 atvavn illain, deinnun atvavn ravrevan deorayyta.

Begin (hakedama 3 amud bet) deit atvavn ravrevan, veit atvavn zeirin. atvavn ravrevin innun leella, atvavn zeirin letatta. vecholla letatta kegavvna dilella. begin deit shemahan kaddishin illain, dekayymin biru derucha velibba bela millula kelal.

Veit shemahan kaddishin tattain, dekayymin bemilla, uvimshichu demachashava ureu alayyhu. veit shemahan acharanin letatta, deinnun mehahu sitra achara, deihu missitra dimsaava, veillen la kayymin, ella biru deovada letatta, lesalleka reu dehahu ovada diltatta legabbeh. begin deihu sitra achara lav ihu, ella beovadin dehay alma, leistaava behon. kegavvna devilam, veinnun bene kedem, vechol innun demitasseke behahu sitra achara.

Veillen, la kayyme beatvavn reshimin min 22 deorayyta, bar teren, veillen 8 106, vesamchin lon bismichu (Bereshit 2 amud alef) atvavn desheker. aval illen innun ishtemodan legabbayyhu yattir. veal da bittehilla ledavid, bechullehu ketiv 6 bechol at veat, bar meillen teren, dela ketiv 6, deha 6 shema dekudesha berich hu ihu.

Ubbegin kach innun arbein uteren atvavn, dealma da itbere behu, ishtechach hay Adonai illaa, lesalleka letishin uteren, tishin havo, bar teren udenin yemina usemala. veraza da (sefer acher vesimanich) (Bereshit 17:17) veim sara havat tishim shana teled. aval ihu bechushbana tishin uteren, vechad ittosaf darga deraza divrit, deihu rekia teminaa, vekayyeyma litmanya yomin, ha mea. veillen vadday mea birchan bechol yoma deitztericha keneset yisrael leitatra behu. vecholla beraza de.

Hay Adonai, ihi diyyukena dilah bitren nunin, raza demea, veinnun chamesh samchin retichin, denafke miggo butzina, veinnun chamesh acharanin denafkin minnah. veal da deyukenaha kegavvna da 50 50, teren nunin, unekuda dekayyma beemtzaita. veal da 6 kayyeyma benayyhu tadir, kegavvna da (235 amud bet) nun, begin dehacha ihu atreh leitatra, veaf al gav derazin acharanin innun beraza de, aval da ihu berazin desifra dechanoch, vehachi hu vadday.

Vechad ittakna beinnun chamshin bilchodayyhu, ihu nekuda chada dekayyeyma beraza den, kegavvna da (Adonai) 50, nun. vechad nekuda beemtzaita deihi shalta alayyhu, vecholla raza chada. zakkain innun deyade archoy deorayyta, lemehach bearche keshot. zakkain innun behay alma, vezakkain innun bealma deate.

Raza telitaa at 6, hay at diyyukena deraza deadam, kema deittemar. veha ukimna, dehay at, kayyeyma al 12 retichin. vechad mitparshan, innun 24 retichin, dichlilan behay at peshitu diyyukena devar nash, lokovel deroin veyarchin vegufa
859: Shayyfin dilhon 24 innun didderoin, veyarchin, vegufa, ha ittemar, aval kullehu setimin begufa, vegufa kayyeyma bechullehu 24, vechullehu retichin kelilan beh begufa, uvegin dichlilan kullehu beh, kayyeyma, 6 peshitu chad.

Gufa chad kalil bechd retichin, veillen innun: resha beshit. gufa beych, veaf al gav dechol retichin innun (nusach acher 10 10) (nusach acher 18) 12 lechol setar, becholla kayyeyma gufa. aval esrim vearba innun shit deresha, deinnun shayyfin leaalaa resha. timni sere chuleyayn dekayyeyma resha, vesamcha gufa alayyhu.

Vechullehu peshitu chad, beresha vegufa, veinnun shittin kullehu kalil lon, deihu raza deshit. veal da shiura deat 6, resha shiura beshit nekudin mammash, gufa betamne sere. kegavvna da kol illen razin mitparshan, leachlela lon begufa, begin didderoin veyarchin kullehu bignizu, veal da kolla itkelil beraza deat 6 udeyyukena dilah.

Vechad shelimu deat da itchaze, keden kol sitrin bishin istatamu, veitparshan missihara, vela itchafyayn, begin deihu mavka kol mashkofin dirkiin, veanhir lah, vela yachla mekatrega leavasha kelal. vechad hay istallak, keden salik veaste umefatte, veyachil lekatrega al kol bene alma, begin deihu melech zaken uchesil, veha okimna.

6 Ihu nehora denahir lesihara, veaf al gav dinhirin saggiin itkelilan beh, nehora denahir lesihara ihu chad peshitu lemalyya lah. veihu raza dealef, reshimu bechol innun razin. vechad nahir lesihara beraza dev nahir lah.

Uvesifra deadam kadmaa, bediyyukenin deatvavn, 6 chad nekuda leella, vechamesh nekudin diltatta, vechen shiura dilah kegavvna da, 6 vechol nekuda kayyeyma beraza deeser, begin delet lacha nekuda dela ashlim leeser, dechol nekuda it beh tesha samchin retichin, vehahi nekuda ashlim leeser. nekuda dimina tesha samchin retichin lah, veihi asara. vechen lismala. vechen lechol sitrin. veal da, kullehu nekudin innun kol chad vechad kelala deeser, ihi uretichoy. vechullehu kelilan behahu peshitu deat 6, begin kach kolla ihu bediyyukena beraza deat 6.

Vechad ayiyil shimsha besihara, (sihara) nafak mehay 6 chad peshitu raza divrit, kegavvna da 3, veda ihu leaala benukeba. vechad itkelil kolla behay peshitu deat 6, keden kayyeyma leshammesha benukeba. veraza da dichtiv, veatta hakerev elecha et aharon achicha, leitkallela (vayyelech 243 amud bet, 191 amud bet) deroa begufa, veet banav itto, illen kol innun retichin vesamchin dileh. deroa semala legabbeh, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 3:45) kach et haleviyyim, leishtakkecha 6 dechalil kolla. bechad peshitu, lemeheve chad.
Veal da ishtechach yichuda behay, yemina usemala veemtzaita, kolla ihu chad. veal da itavid chad peshitu, veikre echad, vela tishkach bar peshitu chad bilchodoy, veda hu chad.

Adonai batraa, itavid chad gufa, behay nekuda deemtzaita. veail bah 6, veishtechach 6 ben 2 nekudin, chad leella, vechad letatta. ucheden, itachid alma illaa, bealma tattaa, veihu chad. veokimna. ata ribbi elazar veribbi abba venashku yedoy. bacha ribbi abba veamar, vavy lealma kad yitkenish shimsha veyitchashshach alma.

Amar ribbi elazar, yarkin letatta, beraza deat 6, mena lan deitkelilu behay at. amar leh, dichtiv, (Malachi 3:22) zichru torat moshe avdi, vela ketiv nevii, leitchazaa decholla itkelil beraza dev, veat 6 ikre chad, veihu chad bilchodaha, ufeshitu chad veha ittemar.

(Shemot 28:1) veatta hakerev elecha vegomer. amar ribbi shimon, la shimesh moshe (nusach acher shimsha) (nusach acher deihu shimsha) besihara, ad deitkelil bechol sitrin beraza dev, kema deokimna. ta chaze, ma ketiv, mittoch bene yisrael lechahano li. lechahen li la ketiv, ella lechahano li, leshimmusha dileh, leshimmusha deat da, leshimmusha dileh vadday. li da at Adonai, leaala uleshammesha 6 baAdonai, lemeheve kolla chad. zakkain innun yisrael,
860: Dealu venafku, veyade beraza dearchoy deorayyta, lemehach beorach keshot.

Mittocha bene yisrael amay mittoch bene yisrael. ella kolla la itkere lemeheve chad kedka yeot, ella mittoch bene yisrael. deha bene yisrael kayyme letatta, leitpattecha archin, uleanhara shevilin, uleadleka butzinin, ulekarva kolla mittatta leella, lemeheve kolla chad, uvegine kach ketiv (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai vegomer.

Veatta hakerev elecha vegomer amar rabbi shimon, kolla ihu keriva, leman deyada leyachada yichuda, ulemiflach lemareh, deha bezimna deishtechach karbena kedka yeot, keden itkeriv kolla kachada, (nusach acher dargin kullehu kechad) unehiru deanpin, ishtechach, bealma beve makdesha, veitkafya veitkasya sitra achara, veshalit sitra dikdushsha binhiru vechidu. vechad karbena la ishtechach kedka yeot, o yichuda la have kedka yeot, keden anpin atzivu. unehiru la ishtechach, veitkasya sihara, veshalta sitra achara bealma, (nusach acher dela itchariv bi makdesha ella begin vechulei) begin dela it man deyada leyachada shema kaddisha, kedka yeot.

Amar rabbi shimon, (80 ba 34 amud alef) kudesha berich hu la nasse leiyyov, vela ata immeh benisyona, kenisyona dishar tzaddikayya, deha la ketiv beh vehaelohim nissa et iyyov, kema dichtiv beavraham (Bereshit 22:1) vehaelohim nissa et avraham. deihu beyadeh akriv livreh yechiday legabbeh. veiyyov la yahiv leh vela masar leh kelum. vela ittemar leh, aval itmesar biyda dimkatrega, bedina dekudesha berich hu. deihu attear lehahu mekatrega legabbeh, ma deihu la baa. deha bechol zimna ata hahu mekatrega leatara al bene nasha, vehacha kudesha berich hu attear legabbeh, dichtiv, (Iyov 1:8) hasamta libbecha al avdi iyyov. aval raza amika ihu.

Patach veamar (Bereshit 4:3) vayhi mikketz yamim vayyave kayin mipperi haadama mincha laAdonai. vayhi mikketz yamim, raza ihu, mikketz yamim, vela mikketz (134 amud alef) yamin, dacha lekketz yamin, vekariv lekketz yamim. veha okimna, dichtiv, (Daniel 12:13) veatta lech lakketz. amar kudesha berich hu ledaniel veatta lech lakketz. amar leh, lean ketz, lekketz hayyamim o lekketz hayyamin, ad deamar leh lekketz hayyamin.

Veal da dachil david, dichtiv, (Tehillim 39:5) hodieni Adonai kitztzi. o lekketz hayyamim, o lekketz hayyamin. vehacha ma ketiv, vayhi mikketz yamim vela mikketz yamin. uvegine kach la itkabbal karbaneh deha missitra achara hava kolla.

Ta chaze ma ketiv, (Bereshit 4:4) vehevel hevi gam hu. may gam hu. leasgaa kolla da beda. karbana kolla veikara dileh hava lekudesha berich hu, veyahiv chulakeh lesitra achara, kema deat amer umechelvehen. vekayin, ikkara aved mikketz yamim, veyahav chulaka lekudesha berich hu, veal da itdacha ihu vekarbaneh.

Beiyyov ma ketiv, (Iyov 1:Adonai) vehalchu vanav veasu mishte vegomer. uchetiv vayhi ki hikkifu yeme hammishte. uchetiv veshalchu vekaru lishloshet achyotehem leechol velishtot immahem, deda ihu ikkara lesitra achara. ulevatar akriv olot, veola ihu dechar, vela nukeba, vesalleka leella, vekarbana la kariv leachlela leh kedka yeot.

Veta chaze, ilmale chulaka yahav lecholla, mekatrega la yachil leh levatar, vei tema amay avish leh kudesha berich hu. ella, begin degarim lechasyya nehora uleitchafyya, veihu la kariv karebbena achara, leattezana beh acharanin, ella ola, desalleka leella, veal da ketiv, kacha yaase iyyov kol hayyamim, deilmale sitra achara ittezanat bechulaka, itavar meal makdesha veistallak minneh, vesitra dikdusha hava salik leella leella.

Aval ihu la baa deithane achara mikarbane, veade garmeh minneh. mena lan. dichtiv, (Iyov 1:1) vesar mera. veal da kariv tadir ola, deha ola la ithane minneh sitra achara lealmin. uvegin kach, kol ma denatil levatar, middideh natil. veal da iyyov garim lechafya arla al berit kayayma, dela hava ade minneh. uvegin kach kudesha berich hu ittear lehahu mekatrega, dichtiv hasamta libbecha al avdi iyyov.
861: Kudesha berich hu leitachada behu beyisrael bemitzrayim, la kayyeyma shaata. begin dearla chafya nehora, ad zimna dehahu mekatrega hava natil dileh meiyyov, veal da pakid leh kudesha berich hu lemechleh lehahu pesach bivhilu, ad dehahu sitra achara ishtaddal beh beiyyov, ufakid leitabbera arla minnayyhu, ucheden itachad kudesha berich hu beyisrael, vehahu sitra achara itperash min kudsha, veishtaddal beh beiyyov, venatil midileh. ucheden (Shemot 12) pesach hu laAdonai vadday. dead hasheta la hava pesach laAdonai. zakkain innun deyade umeyachade yichuda demarehon kedka yeot.

Ketiv (Shemot 34 17) elohe massecha lo taase lach, uchetiv batreh et chag hammatzot tishmor. (may avid) may hay legabbe hay. ella hachi ukemuha, man deachil chametz befesach (keillu avid kochavim umazzalot lemiflach legarmeh, deha raza hachi hu dechametz befesach) keman defalach lekochavim umazzalot ihu.

Ta chaze, kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim nafku mershu dilhon, mershu achara, mehahu reshu deikre chametz, nahama bisha. veal da ikre kochavim umazzalot hachi, veda ihu raza deyetzer hara, pulechana nochraa, deikre uf hachi seor. veda ihu yetzer hara, dehachi ihu yetzer hara bevar nash, kechamir beisa, al bimoy devar nash zeer zeer, ulevatar asge beh, ad dechol gufa itarav bahadeh. veda ihu kochavim umazzalot. veal da ketiv, (Tehillim 81:10) lo yihye vecha el zar. el zar vadday.

Et chag hammatztzot tishmor, ribbi yehuda patach, (Yeshayahu 2:22) chidlu lachem min haadam asher neshama beappo ki vamme nechshav hu. hay kera ukemuha. aval may chidlu lachem min haadam, vechi azhar leh levar nash leitman mishshear bene nasha. uf innun name legabbeh, yishtachchun bene nasha dela yikrevun illen beillen lealmin. ella ha ukemuha beman deashkim lefitcha dechavreh lemehav leh shelam.

Vaana okimna leh bikra achara, dichtiv, (Mishlei 27:14) mevarech reehu bekol (226 amud bet) gadol babboker hashekem kelala techashev lo. veaf al gav decholla shappir. aval may chidlu lachem min haadam asher neshama beappo. hacha pakid kudesha berich hu levar nash, veazhir leh leistammera meinnun bene nasha, desatu archayyhu meorach tav leorach bish, umesaave nafshayyhu behahu mesaavu achara.

Deha kad bara kudesha berich hu levar nash, aved leh bediyyukena illaa, venafach beh rucha (nusach acher nishmeta) kaddisha, dechalil bitlat kema deokimna, deit beh nefesh ruach uneshama, veella mikkolla neshama, deihi chela illaa leminda, ulemetar pikkudoy dekudesha berich hu. vei hahi nishmeta kaddisha ail lah befulechana achara, hay ihu masiv lah, venafik mippulechana demareh. begin ditlat chelin illen, kullehu chad, nefesh ruach uneshama mishtattefe kachada, vahavu chad, vecholla kegavvna deraza illaa. (al da neemar 1 holech et chachamim vegomer)

Vei chazenan lehay bar nash, dahavo beh illen dargin kullehu. ad la kayyeyma bekiyyumeh leminda man ihu, bemay ityeda (dela) lekarva bar nash bahadeh, o leitmana minne. (sefer acher bar nash deit beh dargin illen kullehu vekayyeyma bekiyyumeh da ihu gevar shelim avda mehemana demareh uvae leishtattefa beh uleitchabbera bahadeh lemelaf orchoy minneh. uvemay ityeyda bar nash leminda man ihu lekarva bahadeh o leitmenaa minneh) berugezeh mammash, yeda leh bar nash, veyishtemoda man ihu. i hahi nishmeta kaddisha natar beshaata derugezoy, (atya aleh) dela yekar lah meatraha, begin lemishre techotah hahu el zar, da ihu bar nash kedka yeot. da ihu avda demarih, da ihu gevar shelim.

Vei hahu bar nash la natir lah, veihu akar kedushsha da illaa meatreh, lemishre beatreh sitra achara. vadday da ihu bar nash demarid bemareh, veasir lekarva bahadeh uleitchabbera immeh, veda ihu (Iyov 18:4) toref nafsho beappo. ihu tarif veakar nafsheh, begin rugezeh, veashre begavveh el zar. veal da ketiv chidlu lachem min haadam asher neshama beappo, dehahi nishmeta kaddisha tarif lah, vesaiv lah, begin appo. asher neshama
862: Achlaf beappo. ki vamme nechshav hu. kochavim umazzalot itchashiv hahu bar nash.

Uman deitchabbar immeh, uman deishtae (sefer acher mishtattef) bahadeh, keman deitchabbar bekochavim umazzalot mammash. may tama. begin dekochavim umazzalot mammash share begavveh. vela od, ella deakar kedushsha illaa meatreh, veshari beatreh kochavim umazzalot el zar. ma el zar ketiv beh (Vayikra 19:4) al tifnu el haelilim, kegavvna da, asir leistakkela beanpoy.

Vei tema ha rugeza derabbanan. rugeza derabbanan tav ihu lechol sitrin, deha tanenan deorayyta eshsha ihi, veorayyta ka martecha leh, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 23:29) halo cho devari kaesh neum Adonai. rugeza derabbanan bemille deorayyta. rugeza derabbanan lemehav yekara leorayyta, vecholla lefulechana dekudesha berich hu havi, lechach neemar (Devarim 4:24) ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla hu el kanna.

Aval i bemillin acharanin, lav pulechana dekudesha berich hu hay, begin divchol chattaim deka avid bar nash, lav ihu kochavim umazzalot mammash kehay, veasir lekarva bahadeh dehay. vei tema ha leshaata hava, deavar vehadar ahdar. lav hachi, dechevan deiakar kedushsha denafsheh minneh umeatreh, vehahu el zar, makpach hahu atar, ittakkaf beh, vela shavik leh. bar kad itdache bar nash mikkol vachol, veakar leh lealmin, ulevatar ishtaddal leitkaddesha uleamshacha kedushsha aleh. keden ulevay deitkadesh. amar leh ribbi yose, itkaddash mammash. (sefer acher amay veha itdache veitkaddash)

Amar leh ta chaze, beshaata deihu akar kedushsha denafsheh, vesharya beatreh hahu el zar deikre tame, isteav bar nash, vesaiv leman dekariv bahadeh, vehahi kedushsha akrat minneh, vechevan deakrat minneh zimna chada, kamma deyaavid bar nash od, la tituv leatraha.

Amar leh i hachi, kama misavin innun demmitdakkan. amar leh shani misavu achara, dela yachil lemebad yattir. aval da shanya mikkolla, dechol gufa saiv miggo umibbar, venafsha, vecholla masiv. ushear misavu dealma, lav ihu ella gufa levar bilchodoy, ubbegin kach ketiv chidlu lachem min haadam asher neshama beappo, deachlaf kedushsha demareh begin appo, deda ihu misavu demasiv kolla. ki vamme nechshav hu. bama kochavim umazzalot vadday nechshav ihu.

Ta chaze, hay ihu rugeza deihu kochavim umazzalot, sitra achara, kema deamaran, devae bar nash leistammera minneh uleitparasha mealoy, veal da ketiv (Shemot la) elohe massecha lo taase lach. lach: begin leavasha garmach. uchetiv batreh et chag hammatztzot tishmor. tishmor: da sitra dikdushsha, devae bar nash lenatra leh, vela yachlaf leh begin sitra achara. vei yechlaf leh ha ihu masiv, vesaiv lechol man dekariv bahadeh.

Et chag hammatztzot tishmor, hay ihu atar deikre shamor. ubbegin kach ketiv, et chag hammatztzot tishmor shivat yamim tochal matztzot kaasher tzivviticha. shivat yamim illen, lav innun keshivat hayyamim desukkot, deinnun illain veillen tattain. veal da, beinnun hallel gamur, uvehani lav hallel gamur, veal deinnun letatta, shivat yamim tochal matztzot. matztzot ketiv chaser bela 6, dead la sharan innun yomin illain, raza dev.
Vei tema, kevan dehay raza dechag hammatztzot itkaddash, amay nachta, deha tanenan maalin bakkodesh vela moridin, amay nachta letatta beinnun yomin tattain.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Vayikra 16:6) vechipper baado uvead beto vegomer, man diychapper, itzterich (nusach acher lechappara) aleh bekadmita, uvatar al beteh. kegavvna da, hay darga, shaari leitkaddesha ulenafka bikdusha, lechappera aleh, vechevan deihu itkaddash, bae lechappara al beteh, ulekaddesha lon, veal da nachta letatta lekaddesha beteh. uvemma mekaddesh lon, beyisrael diltatta. bechushebana deomer vechevan deillen mitkadshan, baenan lesalleka lah leella, deha kad beta dematronita itkadshat, keden salkat leella, leitkashshera beinnun yomin illain
863: Veal da anan avdin chushebana, bekiyyuma al kayymin, begin deinnun yomin, yomin illain innun, vechen bechol zimna deal bar nash leinnun yomin illain, ben bitzlota, ben bishvacha, itzterich lekayyeyma al ragloy, yarkin vegufa kachada tamman. yarkin vegufa lekayyeyma, kidchura dekayyeyma becheleh, vela kenukeva dearchaha lemetav. veod begin shevacha dealma illaa.

Uvegin deihu raza didchura, nashim peturot mechushebana da, vela mitchayyvan lemimni bar dechurin, leitkashshera kol chad kedka yeot. kegavvna da, (Shemot 23:17) yerae kol zechurecha, dechurin, vela nashin. begin deraza divrit bidchura ihu, vela benukeba, uvegin dekayyeyma raza leella, nashin la mitchayyvan.

Veraza olifna hacha, divchol shivat yomin, meillen yomin illain, natla kedushsha yoma chad (vametaachad) deillen tattae, vehay tattaa ikre shavua, deitkaddash beshiva yomin illain. vechen bechol shiva veshiva meinnun chamshin yomin, ad vela ad bichlal, vechad ishtechachu arbein utesha yomin illain, ishtechachu letatta sheva yomin, deitkaddashu behu vechol chad ikre shavua, deal beinnun sheva. veal da ketiv, (Vayikra 23:15) sheva shabbatot temimot tihyena. begin deinnun nukevin, nakat kera lishana denukevin.

Vechad itkaddashu behu, uveta, mittatkena leitchabbera itteta bevalah, keden ikre chag shavuot, meinun nukeve desharu alayyhu innun yomin illain, deitkaddashu behu. ubbegin kach ketiv beshavuotechem, innun dilchon, vela ketiv beshavuot, begin dehachi name mitkaddeshin yisrael letatta immehon.

Veal da kad matun letesha vearbein yomin, hahu yoma illaa dealayyhu, deihu yoma dechamshin, deshallit al tisha vearbein yomin, raza dichlala deorayyta, betisha vearbein anpin, ucheden hahu yoma illaa, yoma dechamshin, beitaruta diltatta, appik orayyta kelala betisha vearbein anpin.

Ribbi elazar patach veamar, (Tehillim 84:4) gam tzippor matza vayit uderor ken lah asher shata efrocheha et mizbechotecha vegomer. gam tzippor matza vayit, illen tzippore shemaya, deminnehon shavyayn madorehon levar, uminnehon shavyayn madorehon beveta, kegon deror, deihu ofa deshavve diureh beveta dechol bar nash, vela dachil. amay. begin decholla karan leh deror. may deror. chiru, kema deat amer, (Vayikra 25:10) ukeratem deror, vetargumo chiru. veda ihu tzippor deror. deha miyyoma deavid kinna beveta appik benin, madoreh beveta chamshin yomin, ulevatar mitparshan illen meillen, veda hu ofa deikre deror: chiru.

Ta chaze ma ketiv, vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim shana ukeratem deror baaretz. mehacha nafka chiru lecholla, uvegin denafka minneh chiru, orayyta denafkat minneh ikre chiru. veal da ketiv, (Shemot 32:16) charut al halluchot, al tikre charut, ella cherut, veda orayyta deitkere cherut deha ma deappik yoma da illaa, ikre chiru, veihu chiru decholla. vehay yoma ihu chiru illaa, begin deit chiru tattaa, vechiru illaa. hei illaa, hei tattaa. chiru illaa. chiru tattaa shemitta veyovel kachada innun.

Teren nahame achlu yisrael, chad, kad nafku mimmitzrayim, achlu matztza, lechem oni. vechad bemadbera, lechem min hashshamayim. (chad befesach vechad bishvuot) dichtiv, (Shemot 16:4) hinni mamtir lachem lechem min hashshamayim veal da karbana deyoma da nahama ihu. veal nahama, itkerivu kol shear karbanin. denahama ihu ikar, dichtiv, (Vayikra 23:18) vehikravtem al hallechem shivat kevasim vegomer, uchetiv (Vayikra 23:17) mimmoshvotechem taviu lechem tenufa vegomer, deda ihu nahama deachkimu beh yisrael, chachmeta illaa deorayyta, vealu bearchaha.
Hasheta it lan leistakkela, bappesach nafku yisrael minnahama deitkere chametz, ketiv, (Shemot 13:7) vela yerae lecha chametz, uchetiv (Shemot 12:19) ki kol ochel machmetzet
864: May taama. begin yekara dehahu nahama deitkere matztza. hasheta dezachu yisrael lenahama illaa yattir la yeot hava leitbattela chametz, vela itchazya kelal. vaamay karbana da, chametz hava, dichtiv solet tihyena chametz teafena. vetu, dehashta beyoma da itbattal yetzer hara, veorayyta deitkere chiru ishtechachat.

Ella, lemalka dehava leh bar yechiday, vechalash. yoma chad hava taiv lemechal, amru yechul bereh demalka (sefer acher mechla deasvavta da) asvavta da, vead deyechul leh, la yishtekach mechla umezona achara beveta. avdu hachi. kevan deachal hahu asvavta, amar mikkan ulehala yechul kol ma deihu taiv, vela yachil lenazka leh.

Kacha kad nafku yisrael mimmitzrayim, la have yade ikara veraza dimhemnuta, amar kudesha berich hu, yitamun yisrael asvavta, vead deyechlun asvavta da, la itchaze lehon mechla achara. kevan deachlu matztza, deihi asvavta lemeal uleminda beraza dimhemnuta. amar kudesha berich hu, mikkan ulehala itchaze lon chametz, veyechlun leh, deha la yachil lenazka lon. vekol shekken divyoma deshavuot, izdaman nahama illaa, deihu asvavta becholla.

Veal da mekarvin chametz, leittokda al madbecha. umekarvin teren nahamin acharanin kachada. vechametz, ittokda benura demadbecha vela yachil leshalletaa, ulenazkka lon leyisrael. uvegine kach, yisrael kaddishin itdavaku beh bekudesha berich hu, beasvavta deorayyta beyoma da. veilmale havo natre yisrael teren sitrin denahame illen, la havo ayylin bedina lealmin.

Beyoma derosh hashshana, deihu yoma dedina, (bechol yoma) delav ihu, ella leinnun dela natlu mechla deasvavta, veshavku leasvavta deorayyta, begin mechla achara deihu chametz. deha beyoma da derosh hashshana, hahu chametz salleka, umekatrega aleh devar nash, vealshin aleh, veihu kayyeyma beyoma da mekatrega al alma. vekudesha berich hu yativ bedina al kolla vedain alma.

Uvegine kach kad yahav kudesha berich hu orayyta leyisrael, atim lehu mehahu nahama illaa, dehahu atar, umiggo hahu nahama, havo yadin umistakkelin beraze deorayyta, lemehach beorach meshar, veha ukemuha milla innun chavrayyay berazin (sefer acher illen dekaamaran) illen kidkamran.

Ribbi shimon veribbi elazar bereh, havo azle bearcha, vahavu azlin immehon, ribbi abba veribbi yose, ad dahavo azle iarau bechad sava, vahava achid bideh chad yannuka, zakaf enoy ribbi shimon vechama leh, amar leh leribbi abba vadday millin chadtin it gabban behay sava.

Kad matu legabbeh, amar ribbi shimon, bematul dekkufetrach begabbach ka atit, man ant. amar leh, yuday ana. amar, millin chadtin vadday yoma da legabbach, amar leh lean hu arach. amar leh, diuri hava beinnun perishe madbera, dahavena, mishtaddal beorayyta, vehasheta atena leyishuva, lemetav betzilla dekudesha berich hu, beillen yome deyarcha sheviaa da.

Chadde ribbi shimon, amar, netiv, devadday kudesha berich hu shadrach legabban. amar leh, chayyecha denishma milla mippumach, meinnun millin chadtin attikin, dintatun tamman bemadbera, mehay yarcha sheviaa. vaamay itperashtun hasheta mimmadbera, lemete leyishuva. amar leh hahu sava, bishelta da, yedana dechachmeta gabbach, umillach matu lirkie dechachmeta. (sefer acher natu latekayav dechachmeta)

Patach hahu sava veamar, (Devarim 1:31) uvammidbar asher raita asher nesaacha Adonai elohecha kaasher yissa ish et beno vegomer. hay kera hachi mibbae leh, uvammidbar asher nesaacha, mahu raita. ella kudesha berich hu davar lon leyisrael bemadbera, madbera takkifa, kema dichtiv, (Devarim 8:15) nachash saraf veakrav vegomer. umadbera deihu takkif mishshear madverin bealma. may taama.
865: Yisrael mimmitzrayim veishtelimu leshittin ribbevan, ittakkaf malchuta kaddisha, veistallak al kolla, vesihara itnehirat ucheden itkafya malchu chayyayva sitra achara. veappik lon kudesha berich hu lemehach bemadbera takkifa. deihu atar veshultanu desamael chayyayva, deihu dileh mammash, begin letavra tukepeh vecheleh, ulechatteta resheh, (sefer acher valeachetaa leh) uleachpeya leh, dela yishlot. veilmale dechavu yisrael, baa kudesha berich hu leabera leh mealma, veal da abar lon beachasanteh veadveh vechulakeh mammash.

Kevan dechavu bechamma zimnin, nashich lon chivya, ucheden itkeyyaym (Bereshit 3:15) hu yeshufecha rosh vegomer. yisrael machu resheh bekadmita, vela yade leistammera minneh, ulevatar ihu macha bevatrayyta, venaflu kullehu bemadbera, veitkayyaym veatta teshufennu akev. vearbein shenin laku minneh, lokovel 40 malkut deve dina.

Veal da ketiv asher raita, beenayyhu havoy chaman lehahu mare demadbera, azil kafit kamayyhu, venatle achasanteh veadveh. mennalan. middichtiv (Shemot 15:15) az nivhalu allufe edom, veillen innun (Devarim 8:15) nachash saraf veakrav. vaanan uf hachi itperashna miyishuva lemadbera takkifa, uleayyna tamman beorayyta, begin leachpeya lehahu sitra.

Vetu dela mityashshevan mille deorayyta, ella tamman. delet nehora ella hahu denafik miggo chashocha, dechad itkafya sitra da, istallak kudesha berich hu leella, veityaykkar bikareh. velet pulechana dekudesha berich hu, ella miggo chashocha, velet tuva ella miggo bisha. vechad al bar nash beorach bisha, veshavik leh, keden istallak kudesha berich hu bikareh, veal da shelimu decholla tov vara kachada, uleistalleka levatar betov, velet tov ella hahu denafak miggo bisha. uvehay tov, istallak yekareh, veda ihu pulechana shelim.

Vaanan, ad hasheta yativna tamman, kol yome shatta, begin leachpeya bemadbera lehahu sitra. hashsheta demata zimna defulechana kaddisha, desitra dikdusha, ahadarna leyishuva detamman ihu pulechana dileh. vetu, dehashta berosh hashshana mata zimna dehahu chivya, lemitba dina mikkame kudesha berich hu, vetamman ihu shallit. uvegin kach nafakna mittamman vaatena leyishuva.

Patach hahu sava veamar, (Tehillim 81:4) tiku vachodesh shofar bakkese leyom chaggenu, hasheta ihu zimna, leitteara dina illaa takkifa, vechad ihu ittear sitra achara ittakkaf bahadeh, vechevan deihu ittakkaf, salik vechafya lesihara, dela nahir nehora, veitmalya missitra dedina. keden kol alma ihu bedina, illain vetattain, vecharoza kariz bechullehu rekiin, atkinu kuresya dedina, lemareh decholla, deihu bae lemedan.

Veraza hacha, veitnehir lan bemadbera, amay ittear dina illaa beyoma da. ella kol razin vechol kidushin yakirin, kullehu talyayn bishviaa. vehahu sheviaa illaa, alma illaa, deikre alma deate. minneh naharin kol butzinin, vechol kidushin, vechol birkan. vechad mate zimna, lechadtute birkan vekiddushin leanhara, baa leashgacha vechol tikkuna dealmin kullehu, vechol innun tikkunim leitkayyeyma kullehon, sallekin miggo tattae, i innun kashran. vei la kashran, keden kayyeyma (sefer acher milla) dela nahir, ad deitparshan chayyayvin miggo zakkain, keden ittear dina.

Umehahu dina, ittakkaf sitra achara, veishtechach mekatrega, begin deyinatnun leh innun, chayyayvayya. begin dealeh ketiv, (Iyov 28:3) ulechol tachlit hu choker. vechafya lesihara, amay (davar acher lo maseraa lon bida dimkatrega.) begin delet tiuveteh dekudesha berich hu, leovada leovade yedoy.

Vehahu sitra achara, kayyeyma kelifa takkifa, dela yachil leittabbera, bar behahu eta dekudesha berich hu yahiv leyisrael, dichtiv tiku vachodesh shofar bakkese leyom chaggenu. begin letavra hahu kisse deitchafya sihara, vela nahir.

Vechad mitteare yisrael letatta beshofar, hahu kalla denafik mishshofar, batash baavira, uvaka rekiin, ad desalleka legabbe hahu tinara takkifa, (nusach acher sitra achara) dechafe lesihara, ashgach, veashkach itaruta derachame, keden hahu
866: Desalik vekayyeyma leella, itarvav. keden hahu kalla kayyeyma, veabar hahu dina, vechevan diltatta attearu rachame, hachi name leella, ittear shofra achara illaa, veappik kala deihu rachame, veataru kala bekala, rachame berachame, uveitaruta diltatta, ittear hachi name leella.

Vei tema, hech yachil kala diltatta, o ittearuta diltatta leatara, hachi name. ta chaze, alma tattaa, kayyeyma lekabbela tadir, vehu ikre even tava. vealma illaa la yahiv leh, ella kegavvna deihu kayyeyma. i ihu kayyeyma binhiru deanpin mittatta, keden hachi naharin leh milella. vei ihu kayyeyma baatzivu, yahavin leh dina bekavleh.

Kegavvna da, (Tehillim 100:2) ivdu et Adonai besimcha. chedva debar nash, mashich legabbeh chedva achara illaa. hachi name hay alma tattaa, kegavvna deihi itatterat, hachi amshich milella. begin kach mekaddeme yisrael, veatare bashshofar kala deihu (raza derachame) kalil beeshsha umaya verucha, veitavid chad, vesalleka leella, uvatash behay even tava, veitzteba beinnun gavvnin dehay kala, ucheden kema deitchaziat, hachi mashich milleella.

Vechevan deittaknat behay kalla. rachame nafke milleella, vesharyayn alah, veitkelila berachame, mittatta umilleella. ucheden itarbav sitra achara. (istakkal vechame binhiru deanpin) veitchallash tukpeh, vela yachil lekatrega. vehay even tava, kayyeyma binhiru deanpin, mikkol sitrin, binhiru diltatta, uvinhiru dilella.

Ematay kayyeyma binhiru dilella, have omer beyoma dechippure. uveyoma dechippure itnehir hahu even tava, binhiru dilella, miggo nehiru dealma deate, (vaataarabeb hahu daltora) ucheden metakkenin yisrael letatta chad sair, umeshadderin lehay madbera takkifa, deihu shalta aleh.

Vehahu sitra achara, ihu nekuda emtzaita decharivu dealma, begin dechol charivu veshimamon (sefer acher minneh, hu mehahu sitra achara deshallit) mineh, hahu sitra achara shallit aleh. unekuda emtzaita dechol yishshuva, sitra dikdushsha ihu, veal da, kayyeyma yerushala 40 beemtzaita dechol yishshuva dealma.

Bitren nekudin itperashat malchu shemaya, sitra dikdushsha, chad dilah, vechad dealma deate, nekuda illaa temiraa, veal da kayyeyma bitren nekudin: nekuda dilah kayyeyma techotah, yerushala 40, emtzaita dechol yishshuva. nekuda denatla meima illaa temira, (219 amud bet, 281 amud bet) ihu gan eden deara, dekayyeyma beemtzaita dechol alma, lechol sitrin, decharivu veyishuva, vechol sitrin dealma.

Veal da, beemtzaita (132 amud bet) degan eden, kayyeyma nekuda chada illaa temira ugeniza, dela yedia. vechad ammuda, naitz mittatta leella, go hahi nekuda, umittamman nave mayya, deitperishu learba sitre alma. ishtechachu telat nekudin bealma, dekayyman da al da, kegavvna ditlat nekudin deorayyta.

Ta chaze, hahu sair dimshadderin yisrael laazazel, lehahu madbera, begin lemehav chulaka lehahu sitra achara, leitasseka bahadeh. vei tema, teren seirin amay hacha, chad laAdonai vechad lehahu sitra achara. tinach hahu sair desitra achara. laAdonai amay.

Ella lemalka dehava argiz al bereh, kara lesantira, hahu deavid dina bivne nasha tadir, begin deyizdamman lemebad dina bivreh. hahu santira chadde, veal beve malka lemechal tamman, kevan deashgach beh bereh, amar, vadday la al santira da beve abba, ella begin deargiz malka alay. ma aved, azal veitpeyays bahadeh. kevan deitpayays bahadeh, pakid malka lemebad seudata illaa leh velivrih, ufakid dela yada beh hahu santira. levatar al hahu santira. amar malka hasheta i yinda da, misseudata illaa
867: Deatkinit li velivri, yitarbev patora. ma avad. kara lammemana al seudata, amar leh, atkin midi, uteshave kammay, uteshave kammeh dehahu santira, begin deyachshiv desaid kammay middili, vela yinda behahi seudata yakkira dechedva dili vedivri, veyittol hahu chulaka veyezil leh, veyitperash michedva disudata dilan. vei lav demalka avid hachi, la yitperash hahu santira mibbe malka.

Kacha amar kudesha berich hu leyisrael, azminu teren seirin, chad li vechad lehahu daltora, begin deyachshiv demisseudata dili kaachil, vela yinda bisudata dechedva achara dilan, veyissav hahu chulaka, veyezil learcheh, veyitperash mibbeti. kevan deima illaa, alma deate, ate lemishre (100 amud bet) go hechla dealma tattaa, leashkecha nehiru (nusach acher leashgacha ala binhiru) deanpin, din hu dela yishtekach hahu daltora, vela mare dedinin lekammeh, kad appik kol birchan, veanhir lecholla. vechol hahu chiru yishtekach, veyisrael natle meinnun birchan.

Deha kad alma deate, al lehechala dealma tattaa, veashkach dechadde alma tattaa im benoy behahi seudata illaa, keden ihu barich patora, vealmin kullehu mitbarchin, vechol chidu vechol nehiru deanpin ishtechachu tamman. hada hu dichtiv, (Vayikra 16) lifne Adonai titharu. (100 amud bet)
