Ketiv (Vayikra 16:8) venatan aharon al shene hasseirim goralot goral echad laAdonai vegoral echad laazazel. da ihu hahu chedva dehahu daltora, begin dekudesha berich hu yatil immeh goral, vezammin leh, vela yada denur dalik attil al resheh, veal amma dileh, kema deat amer (Mishlei 25:22) ki gechalim atta chote al rosho.

Vesimanicha, (Ester Adonai:12) af lo hevia ester hamalka im hammelech el hamishte asher asata ki im oti. uchetiv, vayyetze haman bayyom hahu sameach vetov lev. behahu chulaka denatil, veazil leh. ulevatar kad ate malka illaa, leve matronita, matronita tavat alaha, veal benaha, veal amma min malka.

Vaafillu bezimna deyisrael begaluta, vetzallu tzelotin bechol yoma, ihi salkat beyoma da, lekame malka illaa, vetavat al benaha. ucheden itgezaru, kol innun nukemin, dezammin kudesha berich hu lemebad im edom, veitgezar hech zamin daltora da leitabbera mealma, kema deat amer (Yeshayahu 25:8) billa hammavet lanetzach.

Vesimanicha, bezimna degaluta (Ester 7:4) ki nimkarnu ani vegomer. ki en hatztzar sho benezek hammelech. may benzek hammelech. kema deat amer, (Yehoshua 7:9) vehichritu et shemenu min haaretz uma taase leshimcha haggadol. deha shema illaa, la itkayyaym bekiyyumeh, veda ihu benezek hammelech.

Ucheden vehaman nivat millifne hammelech vehammalka keden, nehiru deanpin, vechol chidu ishtechach, veyisrael nafke lechiru, behahu yoma. keden mehahu yoma ulehala, chiru vechedva beitgalleya, leshalletaa alayyhu, keden bae lemechode immehon, mikkan ulehala, kema deyahavu leh chulaka leitparsha minhon, hachi name yahavin lishar ammin, leitparsha minnehon letatta.
Ta chaze, ma hu raza dekarbena, lekarva sair, (lekabbel sair) vela milla achara. vaamay sair berosh chodesh, vehacha name sair. ella i tema begin deihu sitra dileh yeot. amay la havi ez.

Ella milla da itzterich, veihi ishtechachat lemarehon decharashin, dechol ovadayyhu bema dela (itchabbar) yehe benukeba. veal da sair la itchabbar benukeba, besitrin dileh kullehu. ez kad itchabbar benukeba. uvegin deihu malka, yahavin leh begin yekara dileh, hay dela itchabbar benukeba, vela yahiv cheleh leachara. veda ishtemoda leinnun charashin, demishtammeshin behane ovade. uvegine kach, sharyayn al hahu sair, kol innun chataehon.

Veta chaze, af al gav deihu chulaka lehahu sitra achara, raza hacha, kol hane sitrin acharanin diltatta, (deikrun metzulot yam) kullehu misavin yattir. vechol ma denachtin dargin tattain, hachi misavu dilhon yattir. uvegin kach, baez yattir chulakehon, begin desaara
868: Dileh talya yattir mibbeira achara, kema dedina dilhon tale letatta bimsaavu. aval hay malku chayyayvta achara, malka decholla behahu sitra, barur ihu yattir misavu dileh, vela misavu shelim kehane tattae. veal da sair, disar dileh la talya, vela sheia. la sheia, begin dehahu misavu dileh. vela talya, begin dela yittakaf beh misavu kehani tattae, veal da vadday sair vela achara.

Kippur, amay ikre kippur, ella begin denaki kol mesaavu, veabar leh mikkameh, behahu yoma. veal da, yom kippur: yoma dinkiuta, vehachi karena leh. ketiv (Vayikra 16:30) ki vayom hazze yechapper alechem letaher etchem, ki hayyom hazze mibbae leh, may ki vayom hazze. ella begin deitdakke makdesha leella, itnake (nusach acher 672) ketiv ki vayom hazze yechapper alechem, yechapper vinake bekadmita bayom hazze, begin deyitdache, ulevatar alechem.

Tu, yechapper bayom hazze, vinake leh bekadmita, vechol da alechem, beginechon itzterich lenakkaa leh, uledakkea leh bekadmita. yechapper, man yechapper. ella da hu alma illaa, denahir venake lecholla. veal da kullehu sitrin bishin, deikrun metzulot yam, itavaru. uchemma deinnun metzulot yam talyayn, hachi name talyay saara (sefer acher dileh, dehu sitra vechulei) dileh kol hahu sitra dilhon, vesaara dehahu sitra la sheia.

Kegavvna da ketiv, (Vayikra 16:16) vechipper al hakkodesh mitumeot beni yisrael umippishehem lechol chattotam. vechol chatotam mibbae leh, ella lehanaa lehon, mikkan ulehala lechol chetam dela yachil mekatrega leshalletaa alayyhu (veal da) beyoma dechippur, deihu kinnucha dechol chovin, venakyu dilhon. baan yisrael lenakkaa garmayyhu, ulemehach yechefe raglin, kemalache illain. chamesh innuyin, begin leistayyeya bechamesh sitrin illain, deyoma dechippure appik lon, veinnun tarin dileh.

Vei shetiyya ka chashiv, deihu missitra deyitzchak, ha shit, veaf al gav devichlal achila ihu, ucheden innun shit, veinnuya batraa tashmish hammitta ihu, uvedarga shetitaa shechiach, velokovleh anan avdin innuya da.

Ketiv (Bamidbar 29:7) uveasor lachodesh hashshevii hazze, uchetiv (Vayikra 23:27) ach beasor lachodesh. beasor, baasiri mibbae leh, may beasor. ella, begin dehashta beyoma da, kol dargin illain, atyayn illen al illen, lemishre al sihara, uleanhara lah. vechullehu beraza deeser, ad desalleka lemea. vechad kayyeyma beraza demea, kaddin kolla chad, veikre yom hakkippurim. veal da beasor, kema deat amar zachor, shamor, dechullehu atyayn begin leasara uleanhara beraza deeser.

Ahdar hay sava resheh lokovleh derabbi shimon, veamar leh, (rabbi shimon) ha yadana dishelta tibbae behay, beasor lachodesh hashshevii. amar leh rabbi shimon vadday, (sefer acher da baasiri yeot hu, vehachi hu, aval beasor amay vechulei) beasor yeot hu. i hachi hu, amay salik lemea, veha mikra la itchaze, ella desalik leshivin, mashma dichtiv beasor lachodesh hashshevii, vechad meassere leshviaa eser zimnin, ha vadday salik leshivin. amar leh, al da ahadarna resha legabbach, deha yadana dechakkima ant.

Ta chaze, teren razin hacha, chad deha sihara chodesh hashshevii ikre, ubbegin kach ikre chodesh hashshevii asor, begin deka menaharin lah eser zimnin, ha mea. vetu, hay milla dekaamrat, vadday leshivin selika behay yoma, (uvedarga deshivin ihu, uvedarga dameah ihu. ledarga dameah leashlema uleanhara.) uvehay darga deshivin, deha beyoma da natil lechol amma deyisrael lemedan, vechullehu kayymin benishmeta yattir miggufa, deha beyoma da innuya denafsha ihu, vela miggufa, kema deat amar veinnitem et nafshotechem ki chol hannefesh asher lo teunne. vehay yoma natil lechol nafshan vahavu birshuteh, vei la kayyeyma beraza (nusach acher birshuta) deshivin, let leh reshu benafshan, (sefer acher lekayyeyma tamman) dekiyyuma denafshan beraza
869: Deshivin, kema deat amer (Tehillim 90:10) yeme shenotenu bahem shivim shana vegomer.

Vei tema nafshan deravye dela ashlimu leshivin shenin la shalta behu. vadday shalta behu, aval la bishlimu, keman dezache yomin saggiin lefikkude orayyta, veim kol da bechullehu shivin shenin azla. veal da tanenan echad hammarbe veechad hammamit. man echad. beyichuda deshivin shenin, man deasge, uman deamit.

Veal da, beyoma dechippure abar bechullehu shivin, veishtelim hay darga bechullehu, vechol nishmatin sallekin kameh, vedain lehon bedina, vekudesha berich hu chayyis alayyhu deyisrael beyoma da, man dela aavar tina mirucheh lechappara aleh, (beyoma da) kad salik tzeloteh behay yoma, tava behahu atar deikre refesh vatit, veihu metzulot (338 163 amud bet) yam vela salik leitattera beresha demalka.

Beyoma da la itzterich bar nash (Vayikra 231 amud alef) lefarsha chataoy kame achara, begin dechamma innun denatle hahi milla, vesalke lah leella, veit sahadin behahi milla. uma (Micha 7:Adonai) mishshochevet chekecha shemor pitche picha, kol shekken innun deazle veayyeyne lekatrega lon, vesahade aleh. vechol shekken dechatzifu ihu lekame kolla, vechilul shema dekudesha berich hu. veal da ketiv, (Kohelet Adonai:Adonai) el titten et picha lachati et besarecha. (mikkan vahala raza begavvavn)

Patach veamar, (Shemot 12:2) hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim vegomer, vechi kullehu zimnin vechodashin lav innun dekudesha berich hu. (ella chadshechem lo ketiv) ella hachodesh hazze lachem, dili ihu, aval ana masrit leh lechon, dilchon ihu beitgalleya, aval sheviaa dili ihu, veal da ihu bakkese, vela beitgalleya. yarcha dilchon, ihu besiddura, keseder deatvavn aviv, deihu 6. 12 ihu raza deg. (sefer acher veihu 6 kesidra deatvavn) aval yarcha sheviaa dili ihu missofa deatvavn. (sefer acher tishre) may taama. attun mittatta leella, vaana meella letatta.

Hay dili. berisha deyarcha, ana ihu beitkasyay. baasara deyarcha, ana ihu, begin daana bechamesh kadmae, uvechamesh acharanin, uvechamesh telitae. bekadmita deyarcha ana ihu, begin chamishsha yomin. baasara deyarcha ana ihu, begin chamesh yomin acharanin. 17 deyarcha ana ihu, begin chamesh telitae.

May tama kule hay. begin dechol yarcha da mealma illaa ihu, vealma illaa beraza dechamesh ihu, bechol zimna vezimna, uvegine kach yarcha da ihu bakkese, vela beitgalleya, begin dealma illaa bakkese ihu, vechol milloy beitkasyay. veyarcha da dekudesha berich hu ihu bilchodoy. kevan demata yoma dechamesar, keden galyay. kolla ihu mata bechadtuta desihara, vesihara ishtelimat, veitnehirat meimma illaa, vekayyeyma leanhara letattae miggo nehora dilella, veal da ikre rishon, kema deat amer (Vayikra 23:40) ulekachtem lachem bayom harishon. ad hasheta kayyme kullehu yomin beraza illaa, mikkan nachtin leraza tattaa.

Ta chaze, miyyoma illaa havo illen yomin kadmain, raza dealma illaa, man dain dina dealma, deha dina la ishtechach behay alma, ella middina tattaa, (sefer acher raza) deda (Yeshayahu 54:5) elohe chol haaretz yikkare. dei tema dina dealma dain leella, i hachi la itkere alma dechiru, alma dinhiru dechol almin. alma dechol chayyin, alma dechol chiru. vei tema middina deyitzchak. i ihu ittear dina legabbe hay alma, la yachlin kol alma lemisbal, dehahu eshsha takkifa illaa, la it man desavil leh, ella eshsha diltatta, deihu eshsha desavil eshsha.

Ella, kema dealma da alma tattaa dechullehu almin. hachi name kol dinoy mealma tattaa, deelohim shofet. veda ikre dina illaa al hay alma, uvegin deihu darga sheviaa, la gazir gezera al bar nash, ella meesrin shenin uleella.
Ashgach hay sava baribbi shimon, vechama leh dezalgin enoy dimin. amar ribbi shimon, i hi sheviaa, amay
870: Meesrin shenin uleella. amar leh, zakkaa man demallil al udenin deshamin.

Ta chaze, be dina diltatta beara, la gazrin dina al bar nash, ad telesar shenin. may taama. begin deshavkin sheva shenin leshviaa, elohe kol haaretz yikkare. velet reshu levar nash beinnun sheva. veinnun sheva, la sharan ella al telesar diltatta, beara deinnun kuresyyay legabbeh, uvegin kach, kol gizrin, vechol dinin diltatta, meinnun sheva shenin diltatta, kelala deesrin shenin ihu.

Vedina dealma berosh hashshana, al yeda dehay darga ihu, deihu mammash kayyeyma bedina al benoy behay alma, begin leitdakkea legabbe alma illaa, begin delet leh siua lesalleka uleitdakkea ella miggo tattae.

Vechad yisrael innun bachamesar yomin, keden natil livnoy, lefarsa gadpoy alayyhu, ulemechode immehon. veal da ketiv ulekachtem lachem bayom harishon, (58 62 amud alef) peri da, ihu ilana deikre etz peri, veishtechach beh peri. etz hadar: kema deat amer (Tehillim 96:6) hod vehadar lefanav. may tama ikre hadar, uman ihu hadar. ella da tzaddik.

Amay ikre hadar, veha atar temira ihu delet leh gilluya, utzericha leitkasyay tadir, velet hadar ella man deitgalyay veitchazze. ella, af al gav deihu darga temira, hiddura ihu dechol gufa, vela ishtechach hiddura legufa, ella beh. may taama. man delet immeh hay darga, let beh hiddura, lemeal bivne nasha. kala lav immeh bidvura, (sefer acher kidchura) vehiddura (sefer acher vedibbura) dekala itpesak minneh. dikna, vehiddura dedikna lav immeh, veaf al gav deitkasyay hahu darga, kol hiddura degufa beh talya. veitkasse veitgalyay. ubbegin kach etz hadar ihu, etz dechol hiddura degufa beh talya, veda ihu (Bereshit 1:12) etz ose peri.

Kappot temarim, hacha itkelilat itteta bevalah bela piruda, kappot temarim (vaychi 220) kachada. vaanaf etz avot, telata. vealin dileh, da besitra da, veda besitra da, vechad deshallit alayyhu. vearve nachal, teren. delet lehu recha vetama, keshokin bivne nasha. (uvegin kach) lulav natil kullehu, kechuta deshidra kayyayma degufa. uma denafik levar tefach, hachi hu, begin leashlema uleappaka kolla, uleshammesha kadka chaze.

(Uvegin kach) behane zinin, bae bar nash leitchazaa kame kudesha berich hu. alin vetarpin dehani temarim, innun kol shear chelin deitachadan beinnun kinnuyayn dekudesha berich hu ikre behon. begin debaenan (sefer acher leitchaddeta) letatta kegavvna dilella, delet lach milla bealma, dela it lah dugema leella, kegavvna dilella hachi it letatta, uveu yisrael leitachada beraza da dimhemnuta, kame kudesha berich hu.
Ketiv (Vayikra 23:42) bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim, da hu raza dimhemnuta, vehay kera al alma illaa ittemar, vehachi tanenan, kad itbere alma, ittemar hay kera.

Kad shara chachma lenafka, meatar dela yedia vela itchaze, keden nafik chad mishchata, uvatash, vehahi chachmeta illaa, natzitz veitpashshat lechol sitrin, beraza demashkena illaa. vehahu mashkena illaa, appik shit sitrin, ucheden hahu netzitzu demishchata nahir lecholla, veamar bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim.

Man sukkot chaser 6. da mashkena tattaa, deihu kaashashita, leachazaa lechol nehorin, ucheden amar, bassukkot teshvu shivat yamim. man shivat yamim. mealma illaa letattaa, dechullehu kayyme bekiyyuma, leanhara lehay sukkot. uman ihi. da (Amos 9:11) sukkat david hannofelet. sukkat shalom. uvae amma kaddisha lemetav techot tzillaha, beraza dimhemnuta, uman deyativ betzilla da, yativ beinnun yomin illain.

Veal da kullehu bassukkot bassukkot vechad basukkot shelim, chad shelim, leachazaa deman deyativ betzilla da, yativ beinnun yomin illain leella, dekayymin al hay tattaa, leanhara leh, lechafya aleh, uleaggana leh, beshaata deitzterich.
Vetu, kullehu ikrun sukkot bishlimu, uchetiv sukkat chaser, da alma tattaa, devaa behane 7 yomin
871: Kaddishin, lemezan lishar memanan ravrevan deammin, beod deihi natla chedva bevalah, vela yekatregun chedvavta, begin deyitravrevun (sefer acher daytaadanevan) behahu mezona, karbanin dilhon saggiin yattir mishshear yomin, begin deyitassekun behu, vela yitarvun levatar bechedva deyisrael. uman chedva deyisrael, da yoma teminaa daatzeret.

Veta chaze, beod deinnun shear memanan chaddan, veachlin behahu mezona dimtakni lon yisrael. innun metakkene kuresyyay lekudesha berich hu mittatta, ulesalleka leh leella, beinnun zinin, uvechedva, uvehillula, uleakfa madbecha. keden ihi salleka, venatla birkan vechedva bevalah.

Ushear chevavn ravrevan memanan deammin, achlan umadkan verafsan veittezanu. veihi nakta nafshan beinnugin leella, kema deittemar. kevan denachta, veha nakta kol birkan vechol kiddushin vechol innugin, veyisrael kol hane shiva yomin havo (Vayikra 294 amud bet) mashchin lah beinnun ovadin deka avdin umekarvin bahadah, keden nachta lekarva bivnaha, ulemechode lon yoma chad, vehahu yoma ihu yoma teminaa, begin dechol 7 yomin acharanin bahadah. veal da ihu teminaa, utemanya yomin kachada. uvegin kach ikre atzeret: kenishin. kenishin kullehu behay yoma. veikre shemini, velet shemini ella miggo shiva.

Ketiv (Iyov 1) yehi shem Adonai mevorach. may mevorach. (ella kolla yade), aval raza chada yada chad mechavrana, bemadbera achziu leh bechelma, veribbi yitzchak kaftora shemeh. may mevorach. sheruta kashe, vesofeh rach. 42 kashe, vedina ihu vadday. (ulevatar kach) kegavvna da, yoma derosh hashshana 42, deha bemv (uveraza 46) atvavn itbere alma, veal da itbere bedina. levatar rach, veal da tanenan, kol sherutin kashin, vesofa dilhon rachin. (sefer acher da 44 uveraza 46 atvavn itbere alma veal da itbere bedina levatar kach kegavvna da) beyoma derosh hashshana 42 kashe bedina. beyoma daatzeret rach bechedva.

Ta chaze, ma ben dina illaa, lehay dina. dina illaa sheruta vesofa kashe, velet man deyekum beh, vechol ma deazil ittakkaf, uvatar deshaari, la salik minneh, ad deachil veshetze kolla, dela ishtear kelum. aval dina achara detatta, sheruta kashe, vechol ma deazil itchalash, ad denahir anpin, kegavvna (sefer acher da dina denukeba) denukeba dechalash chelaha.

Ematay ittear dina dilella lemishre al alma. beyoma detofana. veal da la ishtear kelum bealma, bar hahu tevuta denoach, deihi kegavvna illaa, desavil lehahu tukepa. vei lav dezammin kudesha berich hu, veishtechach berachame al alma, kol alma itavid, dichtiv, (Tehillim 29:10) Adonai lammabbul yashav, veal da la sharya dina dilella al alma, dela yachil alma lemisbal leh, afillu riga chada.

Addehachi hava ribbi shimon bache vechadde. zakfu ayynin, vechamu chamishsha meinnun perushim, dahavo azle avatreh, lemitba leh. kamu. amar ribbi shimon, mikkan ulehala ma shemach. amar, nehoray sava, begin dinhoray achara it gabban. azlu ribbi shimon veinnun chavrayyay immeh telat milin, amar ribbi shimon, leinnun acharanin, ma archa da gabbayychu. amru, lemitba leh lehay sava, dememoy anan shatan bemadbera. ata ribbi shimon uneshakeh, amar leh, nehoray shemach, unehora ant, unehora immach share.

Patach ribbi shimon veamar, (Daniel 2:22) hu gale amikata umessatterata yada ma vachashocha unehora imme shere. hu gale amikata umessatterata, kudesha berich hu galle amikata umessatterata, dechol amikin setimin illain ihu galle lon. umay taama galle lon. begin deyada ma vachashocha. deilmale chashocha la ityeda nehora. veihu yada ma vachashocha. uvegin kach galle amikata umessatterata, dei lav chashocha la yitgalyayn amikin umesatteraan. unehora imme shere. man nehora da. nehora
872: Vaanan miggo chashocha dehava bemadbera, itgele lan nehora da. rachamana yashre immach nehora, bealma den, uvealma deate. azle rabbi shimon vechavrayyay, illen telat milin avatreh, amar leh, amay la azle illen immach kekadmita. amar leh, la beena leatrecha levar nash immi, hasheta deatu nezil kachada. azlu, verabbi shimon azal learcheh. amar ribbi abba, ha anan yedana shemeh, veihu la yada shemeh demor, amar leh, minneh yadana dela leitchazaa. barucha Adonai leolam amen veamen:
873: Al pi bet din, deihu gevura, begin detamman levae, deittemar behu vekiddashta et haleviyyim. ulevatar deitchaze sihara deyeotu leora, mevarech aleha baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam, asher bemaamaro bara shechakim, uveruach piv kol tzevaam. uvemi mitkadeshet umitbarechet, betiferet begin deihu ateret tiferet laamuse vaten. (ad kan raya mehemana) (491 daf 280 amud bet ki yashvu achiv yachdav vechulei)

Ribbi yose veribbi chiyyay havo azle bearcha, ad dahavo azlin ramash lelya, yatvu. adhavo yatvin, sheriat tzafra leanhara, (sefer acher amro kum unehach) kamu veazlu. amar ribbi chiyyay, chame anpoy demizrach deka menaharin, hasheta kol innun bene medincha deture nehora, sagdin legabbe hay nehora, denahir baatar deshimsha, ad la yippuk, ufalchin leh, deha kevan denafik shimsha, kama innun (35 amud alef) defalchin leshimmesha. veillen innun deka palchin linhora da, ukeran lehay nehora, elaha demargela denahir. veomaa dilhon beeloah demargela denahir.

Vei tema pulechana da lemaggana hu. miyyomin attikin kadmae, chachmeta yadu beh. bezimna deshimsha nahir, ad la yippok, hahu memana defakid al shimsha, nafik, veatvavn (130 amud bet) kaddishin dishma illaa kaddisha reshiman al risheh, (deshimsha) uvechela deinnun atvavn, patach lechol kavve shemaya uvatash behu, veavar. vehahu memana al go hahu zohara denahir sacharaneh deshimsha, vetamman shechiach, ad denafak shimsha, veitpashshat bealma.

Vehahu memana, ihu pekida, al dahava, veal margelan sumakan. veinnun palchin lehahu diyyukena detamman, uvenikudin vesimanin deyartu mikkadmae miyyomin attikin, azle veyade nekudin deshimsha, lemishkach atrin dedahava umargelan, amar ribbi yose, ad kama yehon pulechanin saggiin illen bealma, deha shikra let leh kayymin lekayyeyma.

Patach idach (sefer acher rabbi chiyyay) veamar, (Mishlei 12:19) sefat emet tikkon laad vead argia leshon shaker. ta chaze, illu kol bene alma havo palchin leshikra, hava hachi, aval hay nehora vezihara denahir, vadday keshot ihu. kochve ruma dirkia keshot innun. i betippeshu vechesrona dedata dilhon, innun amre vekaran lehu elaha, la bae kudesha berich hu leshetzaa ovadoy mealma. aval lezimna deate la yishtetzun kochavaya unehorin dealma. aval man yishtetze. innun defalchu lon.

Ukera da hachi hu. sefat emet tikkon laad, illen yisrael, deinnun sefat emet. (Devarim 6:4) Adonai elohenu Adonai echad. vecholla ihu emet, veraza deemet, umesayyme Adonai elohechem emet. veda ihu sefat emet tikkon laad.

Vead argia, vead rega mibbae leh, may argia. ella, ad kama yehe kiuma dilhon bealma, ad zimna deyete, viyyhe li nayycha mippulechana kashya dealoy. uvezimna deargia, yishtetze leshon shaker, innun dekaran elaha, leman delav hu elaha. aval yisrael deinnun sefat emet, ketiv behu, (Yeshayahu 43:21) am zu yatzarti li tehillati yesapperu.

Adkarna chada zimna dahavena azil bahade ribbi elazar, paga beh hegmona, amar leh leribbi elazar, ant yadat meorayta diyhudae. amar leh yadana. amar leh, let attun amrin dimhemnuta dilchon keshot, veorayytchon keshot, vaanan dimhemnuta dilan sheker, veorayyta dilan sheker. veha ketiv sefat emet tikkon laad vead argia leshon shaker. anan miyyomin dealma, kayymin bemalchuta, vela adi minan lealmin, dara batar dara, tikkon laad vadday. veattun, zeer hava lechu malchuta, umiyyad ade minnechon, ukera itkayyaym bechu dichtiv vead argia leshon shaker.
Amar leh, chamena bach deant chakkim beorayyta. tippach rucheh
874: Dehahu gavra. illu amar kera, sefat emet konanta laad, hava kidkamran, aval la ketiv ella tikkon, zemina sefat emet detikkon, ma delav hachi hasheta, dehashta sefat sheker kayyma, usefat emet shechiva leafra, uvehahu zimna deemet yekum al kiumeh, umiggo eretz titzmach, keden sefat emet tikkon laad vegomer.

Amar leh hahu hegmon, zakkaa ant. vezakkaa amma deorayyta dikshot yartin. batar yomin shemana deitgeyayr. azlu, matu chad be chakal, vetzallu tzelotehon. kevan detzallu tzelotehon, amru mikkan ulehala nitchabber bishchinta, venezil venitassek beorayyta.

Patach ribbi yose veamar, (Yeshayahu 41:11) hen yevoshu veyikkalmu kol hannechorim bach vegomer. zamin kudesha berich hu lemebad leyisrael, kol innun tavan, dekaamar al yede nevie keshot, veyisrael savlu alehon, kema bishin begalutehon. veilmale kol innun tavan deka mechakkan vechaman ketivin beorayyta, la havo yachlin lemekam ulemisbal galuta.

Aval azlin leve midrashot, patchin sifrin, vechaman kol innun tavan, deka mechakkan, vechaman ketivin beorayyta, deavtach lon kudesha berich hu alayyhu, umitnachamin begalutehon, ushear amin mecharfin umegadfin lon, veamre an hu lahachon, an innun tavan deattun amrin dizminin lechon, vechi kol ammin dealma yichsefun minnayychu.

Hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 66:5) shimu devar Adonai hacharedim el devaro amru achechem sonechem vegomer. may hacharedim el devaro, innun desavlu kama bishin, kama shemuot shame, illen al illen, veillen batar illen, vecharidan alehon, kema deat amer (Yirmeyahu 30:Adonai) ki vegomer kol charada shamanu pachad veen shalom vegomer. innun charedim tadir el devaro kad itavid dina.

Amru achechem sonechem, illen innun achuchon bene esav. menaddechem, kema deat amer (Eicha 4:15) suru tame karu lamo. delet amma deka mevazzin lon beanpe, umerakkekin beanpayyhu leyisrael kivne edom. veamre kullehu misavin kannidda, veda ihu menaddechem. lemaan shemi yichbad Adonai, anan (deamrin) benoy deel chay. di ban yityaykar shemeh. anan shaltanin al alma begin hahu deikre gadol. (Bereshit 27:5) esav beno haggadol. uvishma da ikre kudesha berich hu gadol, (Tehillim 145:3) gadol Adonai umehullal meod. anan bene haggadol, veihu gadol. vadday lemaan shemi yichbad Adonai.

Aval attun zeirin mikkolla, (Bereshit 27:15) yaakov benah hakkatan ketiv, an hu elahachon. an hu innun tavan, deyichsefun kol amamya mechedva dilchon. man yitten venire vesimchatchem kema deattun amrin. vehem yevoshu (ruach hakkodesh omer vehem yevoshu) (sefer acher tu keman) keman detale killata beachara, begin deattun amrin dichden yevoshu veyikkalmu, uvegin da ruach kudsha hava amar milla hachi, veal da, hen yevoshu veyikkalmu kol hannechorim bach. may kol hannecherim bach. deitkafu nechirehon berugeza alach begaluta da. behahu zimna, yevoshu veyikkalmu mikkol tavin diyechomun lehon leyisrael.

Amar ribbi chiyyay hachi hu vadday, aval chamenan vehachi chamu takife alma, deha galuta itmeshach vaadayin bereh dedavid la ate. amar ribbi yose, vechol da hachi hu, aval man avid deyisbelun yisrael galuta da, kol innun havetachot deavtach lon kudesha berich hu. veha ittemar, dealin levatte kenesiyyot ulevate midrashot, vechaman kol innun nechamot, vechadan belibbayyhu lemisbal kol ma deyete alayyhu, veilmale da la yachlin lemisbal.

Amar ribbi chiyyay vadday hachi ihu, vecholla bitshuva talya. vei tema deyichlun hasheta leatara teshuva kullehu kachada. la yachlin. may tama la yachlin. begin dichtiv, (Devarim 30:1) vehaya ki yavou alecha kol haddevarim haelle. uchetiv vahashevota el levavecha bechol haggoyim asher hiddichacha vegomer. uchetiv veshavta ad Adonai elohecha vegomer. ucheden (Devarim 30:4) im yihye niddachacha biktze hashshamayim mishsham yekabbetzcha vegomer. vead dechol innun millin la yitkayyeymun, la yachlin
875: Amar ribbi yose, kama satamt kol archin ushevilin mikkol beni galuta, vela shavkat lon pitchon pe. i hachi, lihvo kema dahavo bechol dara vedara, dela yisbelun galuta vela agra, veyifkun (sefer acher i hachi, lehevo kema dilhon bechol dara vedara, yisbelun galuta velo yifkun) middina deorayyta, veyitarvun bishar ammin.

Patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 26:17) kemo hara takriv laledet tachil tizak bachavaleha vegomer. may kemo hara, arach ihu leubbarta, leabera alah tesha yarchin shelemin. veit bealma kama vechamma, dela avar alah ella yoma chad o teren yomin mitteshiaa, vechol tzirin vachavalin deubbarta bitshiaa innun. veaf al gav dela abar alah ella yoma chada, itchashiv alah keillu itavaru kol teshiaa shelim. uf hachi yisrael, kevan deitame taam galuta, i yahadrun bitshuva, yitchashav alayyhu keillu aberu alayyhu kol innun millin dichtivin beorayyta. kol shekken vekol shekken dechamma vechamma yissurin aberu alayyhu min yoma degaluta share.

Aval may dichtiv, (Devarim 4:30) batztzar lecha umetzaucha kol haddevarim haelle beacharit hayyamim. ta chaze, kamma rachamanuta rachim kudesha berich hu leyisrael bemilla da. lemalka dehava leh bera yechidaa, verachim leh rechimu denafsha, umiggo rechimu dileh, yahav leh leimmeh matronita ditrabbe leh, vetolif leh arche metatkenan. zimna chada chav legabbe avuha, ata avohi vealke leh, ulevatar abar al choveh. tav kemillekaddemin vechav laavuha, veafkeh avuha mibbeteh, veargiz aleh, nafak hahu bera mibbeteh.

Uveatar diyyehach beorach keshot, vihe zakkaa kedka yeot, begin deyishma malka avuha, vihe tiuveteh aleh. ma avad. amar hoil venafakna mehechala deabba, avid mikkan ulehala kol ma daana bae. ma avad. azal veitchabbar bezonot, veitlachlach belichlucha detinnufa bahadayyhu, vela hava mishtechach ella bahadayyhu, bechibbura dilhon. dematronita immeh pakdat bechol yoma al hahu bera, veyadat divrah bahade zonot itchabbar, vechol chavruta dideh bahadayyhu havavt. shariat lemivke, uleitmarra al berah.

Yoma chad al malka legabbah, chama lah deihi mevakka. shail lah al ma at bachat. amra vela evke, deha berana levar mehechala demalka. vela day dehu la yativ behechala demalka, ella dehu yativ bahade zonot. ma yemrun kol bene alma, bereh demalka ihu deyativ beve zonot. sheriat lemivke, uleitchannena lemalka. amar malka, beginach ahdar leh, veant arva dileh. amrat ha vadday.

Amar malka hoil vechach hu, la itzterich leahaddera leh bimama beitgalleya. dechissufa dilan ihu lemehach beginih leve zonot. vei la have kegavvna da, detinef garmeh hachi vechillel yekari. havena ana, vechol chayyaylin dili, azlin begineh bechamma yekar, bechamma bukinas kameh, bechamma mane kerava, mimineh umismaleh, ad dechol beni alma yizdazeun, veyindeun kolla, dibbera demalka ihu. hashsheta kevan deihu tinef garmeh, vechillel yekari, ihu yehdar bitmiru, dela yindeun beh. ahdar legabbe malka, yahaveh legabbe immeh.

Leyomin sarach kemillekaddemin. ma avad malka. appik leh uleimmeh bahadeh miggo hechala, amar tarvavyychu tehachun, vetarvavyychu tisbelun galuta, umalkiuta tamman. kevan detarvavyychu tisbelun kachada, keden yadana divri yetuv kadka chaze.

Kacha yisrael benoy demalka kaddisha innun. achit lon lemitzrayim. vei tema behahu zimna la chavu, gezera degazar kudesha berich hu ben habbetarim hava itchaze lemehve kayyaym, vekudesha berich hu ashgach litren millin, chad begin hahu milla deamar avraham, (Bereshit 15:8) bama eda ki irashenna, da hu
876: Sibba veila. aval ad denafku mimmitzrayim, la have goy, vela itchazu kadka yeut.

Patach veamar, (Shir HaShirim 2:2) keshoshanna ben hachochim ken rayati ben habbanot. baa kudesha berich hu lemebad lon leyisrael kegavvna dilella ulemeheve shoshanna chada beara, kegavvna illaa. veshoshanna desalleka recha, veitberir mikkol shear vevradin dealma, la have ella hahi desalleka ben hachochim. veda archa kedka yeot. veal da zara shivin zugin, dahavo shivin nefesh, veail lon ben hachochim, veinnun chochim, miyyad dahavo innun zugin tamman, seliku anfin vetarpin ushelitu al alma, ucheden parchat shoshana benayyhu.

Kevan devaa kudesha berich hu leappaka shoshana velakit lah mibbenayyhu, keden yavshu chochim, veizderiku, veishtetziu, vela itchashvu lichlum. beshaata deazil lemilkat shoshana da, leappaka bereh buchereh, behahu zimna azal malka go kama chayyaylin ravrevanin veshallitin, im degalin perisan, veappik livreh buchereh bechamma gevurin, veayyte leh lehechaleh, veyativ saggi beve malka.

Kevan dechav legabbe avuha, ochach leh, vealke leh, dichtiv, (Shoftim 2:14) vayyichar af Adonai beyisrael vayyittenem beyad shosim vegomer, sarach kemillekaddemin, umarad beavuha, afkeh mibbeteh. ma avdu yisrael, chamu deha itbadru levavel, itarvu beammaya, nasivu nashin nachriyyot, veolidu benin minnehon. im kol da, ima kaddisha havat appotropposa alayyhu.

Veal deavad hachi, kudesha berich hu amar, hoil vechissufa ihu, lete beri ihu miggarmeh, hoil vechillel yekari, la itchaze deana ezil tamman leappaka leh, ulemebad leh nissin ugevuran kemillekaddemin. tavu innun, bela siyyua deitchazu lon, bela pelian venissin, ella kullehu mitbadderan, kullehu lean bemiskenu, vetavu lehechala demalka bechissufa, veema kaddisha arvat lon.

Chavu kemillekaddemin. ma avad kudesha berich hu. appik lehay bera kemillekaddemin mehechaleh, veimmeh bahadeh. amar, mikkan ulehala, ima uverah yisbelun kama bishin kachada, hada hu dichtiv, (yeshaya 3) uvefishechem shullecha immechem. veal da ketiv, (Devarim 4:30) batztzar lecha umetzaucha kol haddevarim haelle beacharit hayyamim. may beacharit hayyamim. ella da hi ima kaddisha, dehi acharit hayyamim, veimmah savlu kol ma desavlu begaluta.

Veillu yehadrun betiyyuveta, afillu chad bish, o chad tzaara, diavar alayyhu, itchashev alayyhu, keillu savlu kolla (sefer acher vei lav satim kitza) vei la, kad yistayem kitza, (bisha) vechol darin dileh. kema deamar butzina kaddisha, dichtiv, (Vayikra 25:30) litztzemitut lakkone oto ledorotav. vechol da, betiyyuveta talya milleta. amar ribbi chiyyay, vadday hachi hu. veal da galuta itmeshach.

Aval kudesha berich hu, kol ma dechame (sefer acher demata) (nusach acher dalka) lon leyisrael, behay acharit hayyamim, uvehay acharit hayyamim yaavid lon nissin venukemin, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 2:2) vehaya beacharit hayyamim nachon yihye har bet Adonai berosh heharim. man rosh heharim. da avraham sava, (252 amud bet) kahana rabba, rosh decholla. uvegin deihu rosh, kos divracha, yihye nachon berosh heharim, da avraham sava, kadmaa lishar heharim. kos divracha, itzterich lemeheve metakkena bimina.

(252 Amud bet) venissa (112 amud bet) miggevaot. itzterich lemehve zakif min pattora, shiura deikre (sefer acher deihu) zeret, levarcha lekudesha berich hu, veda hu venissa miggevaot. miggevaot may hu. ella bena, uven betulot achareha reoteha, shiura dezeret ihu. nisa kos divracha miggevaot vadday, veal da tava dihe leh lehay bera buchera, beacharit hayyamim ihu.

Amar leh shappir kaamart, hay kera vadday hachi hu. berosh heharim, da yemina, avraham sava, deihu rosh heharim vadday. venissa miggevaot, mishshiura digvaot, deinnun reuteh. veshappir kaamret. (Yeshayahu 2:2) venaharu elav kol haggoyim. may hu. amar leh, vaafillu nashim uketannim veshammash defalach al pattora, af al gav deihu la achal, itzterich lemishma, ulememar amen. (sefer acher leharik beracha lachos dela vechulei) dela yiyima bar nash, ana la achalit, vehoil
877: Dela itzterifna lezimmun, la eshma vela ema amen. hakkol chayyayvin beh.

Davar acher venaharu elav kol haggoyim, af al gav denashim uketanim peturin min hammitzvot, bechos divracha hakkol chayyayvin, bilvad deyindeun leman mevarchin, veda hi venaharu elav kol haggoyim. ata ribbi yose uneshakeh, amar kama shappir milla da, umetika lechikka.

Hasheta it ledayyka, i hay acharit hayyamim, ihu kos divracha mammash, mahu har bet Adonai, hava leh lemichtav hachi, vehaya acharit hayyamim nachon yihye berosh heharim. mahu beacharit hayyamim nachon yihye har bet Adonai. amar leh, acharit hayyamim ihu ilana kolla, meresheh vead sefeh, dehu ilana detov vara. veata kera levarra beacharit hayyamim, veappik har bet Adonai, da tov bela ra. har bet Adonai vadday delet tamman chulaka lesitra achara, deha itberir har bet Adonai, miggo ilana deihu acharit hayyamim. veda ihu kos divracha, deihu nachon berosh heharim.

Amar ribbi yose, zakkaa archa da, dezachena lehay milla. amar leh mimman shamat lah. amar leh, yoma chada havena azil bearcha, ushemana vachamena leh lerav hamenuna sava, (nusach acher lerabbi shimon) dehava darish lehay kera leribbi acha, vechevan deshamana chaddena beh, unetirnna leh tzarir bechanfa dilvushai, dela yitade minnay lealmin. amar leh, vadday milla kaddisha da, minnehiru devutzina kaddisha itnehir. zakkaa dara, dekayyme alma vesamchoy, sharyayn begavveh. vei ant tzerirat lehay milla bekishra chada dela yitade minach. ana etzror lah bitllatin, o bearbein kishrin bechisai, dela yitade minnay lealmin. (kan chaser).

Al hahi milla deachme kudesha berich hu lemoshe, begin deaf al gav deyisrael chavin kameh bechol dara vedara, la bae man deyema alayyhu daltorin. menalan. mehoshea, dichtiv, (Hoshea 1:2) techillat dibber Adonai behoshea, ha ukemuha milla. veal da (Hoshea 2:1) vehaya mispar bene yisrael kechol hayyam vegomer. uvegin da barich lon bechamma birkan, leahaddera betiyyuveta, uleatava lon legabbe avuhon devishmayya, vela ade mittamman, ad dekudesha berich hu machal al chovayyhu, veitnekiu kameh.

Eliyyahu ma ketiv beh, (Melachim 1 19:4) vayyavo vayyeshev tachat rotem echad vegomer, amar mareh dealma, itteta chada shadrat lon leyisrael, udevora shemah, dichtiv, (Shoftim 4:Adonai) vehi yoshevet tachat tomer devora. da hu rotem, veahadrat lon lemutav, dichtiv, (Shoftim Adonai:7) ad shakkamti devora. veana alit benayyhu, veachrazit kamayyhu vela yachilna.

Ad dehava yativ, itgele aleh kudesha berich hu, amar leh ma lecha fo eliyyahu, bekadmita ka havet mekatrega umekanne al berit, umiddechamena bach dekannit alay behahu berit, natlit leh biru demoshe, veyahivna lacha, ad demoshe (212 amud alef) hava amar (Bamidbar 25:12) hinni noten lo et beriti shalom. hasheta deihu dilach, la itchaze lach lekatrega aloy, hava lecha lemishbak kinuyaycha li, kema bekadmita dehava dili, shevakna leh lida achara, vela katrigna aloy.

Ma lecha fo, may fo. berit kayyayma, pe Adonai ihu. kevan dela baat leshavka li pumach, yetuv baatar dehahu puma. tenan, behahi shaata, itabbar minneh hahu nevazbeza deyahav leh moshe. ditnan, may dichtiv, (Melachim 1 19:8) vayyelech bechoach haachila hahi vegomer. ad har haelohim choreva. lemitba mittamman, vechi mittamman hava bae. ella lemitba kemillekaddemin, mehahu deyarit behar haelohim, berit da. pinchas hu eliyyahu, vadday bedarga chada. amar leh moshe, let ant yachil lekabbela minnay, ella zil leyannokayyeyhu deyisrael, umeinnun tirvach, veinnun yahave lach, vechach hu avid. (chaser).
Kama tivu avid kudesha berich hu bechol dara vedara leyisrael. ta chaze, ma ketiv, (Micha 6:4) vaeshlach lefanycha et moshe aharon umiryam. veha kama nevie havo levatar moshe,
878: Vaeshlach lefanycha et moshe aharon veelazar ufinchas yehoshua veeliyyahu veelisha, vechamma shear tzaddike vachaside mibbae leh. illen telata amay. ella amar kudesha berich hu, ammi, banay, amay la tidkerun lechol tavin daavadit lechu, deshaddarit lechu lemoshe aharon umiryam.

Lemelecha basar vadam, deit leh medinta, veshadar legabbah, guverin, ipparkin ravrevanin, dihon menahale amma, umeayynin behu, uvedinayyhu. man itzterich lemeheve zakuk bimzonayyhu, bemillin deyyitzterichun. lav amma dimdinta, baal karchayyeyhu yitzterachu leayyna behu, ulemehav lehu yekara.

Shaddarit lemoshe, ihu ayyte kamayychu man lemechal, venahil lechu ulevanayychu velivirayychu, veishtedal bedinayychu, (sefer acher bimzonayychu) uvechol ma deitzterich lechu. shaddarit leaharon, ayyte (sefer acher lechu anane) hechalin daanani yekar lechoppaa alayychu, kemalchin. asche lechu betalle yekar, dela itrakvu levushechon uminalechon, vahavu mitchaddeshe bechol yoma. shaddarit lemiryam, ayytiat bera leashkaa lechu, veshatitun attun uveirchon. innun yahavu lechon, umiddilehon achaltun veshatitun, viytivtun bechuppaa dikar dilhon. umiddilchon la yahavtun lon. velo od, ella deishtaddelu alechon, venatlu al tzavarehon matulechon, vahavitun mecharfin umegadfin lon.

Amar ribbi yose, lav hava abba rachaman al benoy kekudesha berich hu, ukera hu dichtiv, (Melachim 1 8:56) lo nafal davar echad mikkol devaro hattov vegomer. ta chaze rachmanu dileh, illu amar lo nafal davar echad mikkol devaro vela yattir, noach lealma dela itbere. aval middeamar mikkol devaro hattov, veappik bish laachora, deha milla devish la bae lemebad.

Veaf al gav deagzim, vearim retzua, atat ima veittakafat bidroeh yemina, vekam retzua bekiyyumeh, vela nachit letatta, vela itavid, begin diveta chada havo tarvavyyhu, ihu deagzim, veihu daachidat biymineh.

Vei tema menalan. mimmilla deihi beitgalleya, dichtiv lech red ki shichet ammecha, sare learama retzua, umoshe dela hava yada archa deima, shatik. kevan dechama kudesha berich hu kach, ankid leh, uvatash beh veamar veatta hannicha li, miyyad argish moshe, veachid bidroeh dekudesha berich hu, dichtiv zechor leavraham, da deroe yemina, ubbegin kach la nachit retzua.

Vei tema, ima deihi regila leachada birtzua demalka, an havat, deshavkat milla lemoshe. shailna vaamena veha la yedana berira demilla, ad denheve kameh devutzina kaddisha. kad atu lekameh derabbi shimon, chama beanpayyhu siman. amar ulu bene kaddishin, ulu rechimin demalka, ulu rechimin dili, ulu rechimin illen beillen.

Deamar ribbi abba, kol illen chavrayyay, dela rechimin illen leillen, istalaku mealma ad la mata zimnayyhu, kol chavrayyay beyomoy derabbi shimon, rechimu denafsha verucha hava benayyhu, ubbegin kach bedara deribbi shimon beitgalleyay hava, dehava amar ribbi shimon, kol chavrayyay dela rachamin illen leillen, garmin dela lihach beorach meshar. veod deavdin pegimu bah, deha orayyta rechimu veachava ukeshot it bah. avraham rachim leyitzchak, yitzchak leavraham, mitchabbekan da beda, yaakov tarvavyyhu achidan beh, birchimu, uveachava, yahavin ruchayyhu da beda. chavrayyay kehahu dugema itzterichu, vela lemebad pegimu.

Kevan dechama siman beanpayyhu, veamar lon hachi. amru leh vadday ruach nevua shara al butzina kaddisha, vehachi itzterich lan leminda. bacha ribbi shimon veamar, chad milla meinnun millin dilchishu li miggo resh metivta deginta deeden, dela amru beitgalleya milla da sitra ihi, veema lechu banay rechimay, banay rechimin denafshay, ma aavid, amaru li bilchisha, vaana ema beitgalyay. ulezimna denechome anpin beanpin,
879: Banay. chova deavdu (erev rav) amma dilvar. veishtattafu beh amma kaddisha, beimma chavu, dichtiv kum ase lanu elohim, elohim vadday. kevod yisrael da, ihu desharya alayyhu keimma al benin, veda hu raza dichtiv, (Tehillim 106:20) vayyamiru et kevodam betavnit shor. da kevodam deyisrael, imma dilhon. veda hu dichtiv, (Shmuel 1 4:21) gala chavod. degarmu lishchinta deitgele begaluta immehon. veal da vayyamiru et kevodam, bema. betavnit shor.

Hacha ihu raza demilla, ta chaze, letatta go shemarim dechamra, duredyayn bishin, nafak chad irura, mekatrega, mazika kadmaa, veihu beraza diyyukena deadam. kad kariv lego kudsha. kevan deitavar mittamman, uvae lenachta letatta. bae leitlabbesha bilvusha, lenazka alma. venachit hu uretichoy. ulevusha (193 amud bet) kadmaa deka nakit, tavnit shor, diyyukena deshor, vekadmaa lannezikin meinnun arba, shor ihu. veinnun arba (118 amud alef) avot lenazka alma. vechullehu telata deavot nezikin bar shor, kullehu dileh, veal da ketiv, vayyamiru et kevodam betavnit shor.

Mahu ochel esev. ha darshinan beh. aval ikkara demilla, mittamtzit delechem veshiva zine dagan, let leh behu chulaka. uvegine kach, ima la havat tamman, vela yeot lah lemehve tamman. uvegin deabba hava yada rachamanu deima vearcha dilah, amar lemoshe, beni rechimay, eta betarvavyyhu beda tadir. veda hu dilchishu li bilchishu, dela chaze legallaa, dibbera la yinda, veyechme deha retzua ittaknat, veyidchal tadir. aval tarvayyhu beeta da, uveeta chada.

Ta chaze ketiv (Shemot lak) vayyar haam ki voshesh moshe. man haam. innun erev rav. man erev rav. vechi ludim vechushim vechaftorim vetugarmim havo, dekaran lon erev rav, vahalo mitzriyyim havo, umimmitzrayim natlu, veillu havo irbuveya deammin saggiin, hachi hava leh lemichtav, erev rav alu ittam lefi irbuveya dilhon.

Ella (Shemot 12:38) erev rav ala ittam. amma chad hava, velishan chad, aval kol charashe mitzrayim, vechol chartume dilhon havo, dichtiv behu, (Shemot 7:11) vayyaasu gam hem chartumme mitzrayim. devau lemekam lokovel pelian dekudesha berich hu, kevan dechamu nissin ufelian deavad moshe bemitzrayim, ahadru legabbe moshe. amar leh kudesha berich hu lemoshe, la tekabbel lon. amar moshe, mareh dealma, kevan dechamu gevureta dilach, baan leitgayyeyra. yechomun gevuretach bechol yoma, veyindeun delet elaha bar minach. vekabbil lon moshe.

Amay kara lon erev rav. ella kol charashin demitzrayim havo, uvereshehon (balak 194 amud alef) yonos (amro hamegayhaym ulay ellu hem yochani umamre shennizkeru beshemot Rabba parashat 9 daf amud bet 73 shura 31 amro yochani umamre el moshe teven atta machnis laapareyym) veyyimberus, uveshaatte deyoma havo avde tadir charashayyhu. vechol illen charashin illain, havo mistakkele mikki nate shimsha, mishsheruta deshit shaot umechtza, ad sheruta detesha umechtza. dehayynu erev ravreva. kol innun charashin zeirin, mishsheruta detesha umechtza, ad palgut lelya.

Innun illain divhu, havo mistakkele mikki nate shimsha. deha keden sharan tesha mea vetishin vachamesh dargin, limshatteta al ture chashuch. verucha dilhon, hava (balak 191 amud alef) meshatteta al kol innun charashin (nusach acher dargin) becharshayyhu. veillen havo avde, kol ma deinnun baan. ad dechol mitzrae rachtzanu dilhon beillen hava. vekaran lon erev rav. begin deit erev zeera, mittesha shaot
